title: (Staff / Senior Staff) AI Inference Reliability Engineer, Compute Infra
description:
About The Role 

We're looking for a software engineer, reliability-minded but still a builder, to own what happens in production to the Kubernetes-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. The platform team builds the manifest-driven API and controllers that let the inference team declare what they need, a cluster, a model deployment, a capacity change, and get it reconciled underneath. Your job is to keep that promise true in the real world: triaging InfiniBand issues when prefill and decode nodes stall exchanging KV cache over RDMA, diagnosing hero-model and LoRA-serving faults that don't show up in generic health checks, and extending the automated self-healing system so each new failure mode becomes a permanent fix instead of a recurring page.

The core value we're after is keeping the decoupling real even when things break, and keeping the fleet efficient without that efficiency becoming a new source of instability. You'll own SLOs and error budgets for inference serving, lead incident response, and turn what postmortems teach you into actual changes in the controllers and automation, not just updated runbooks. You'll also work the reliability side of capacity efficiency, since a mistuned defragmentation or bin-packing pass is itself a production risk. Strong candidates have hands-on production-reliability experience on large-scale distributed or GPU-serving systems, are comfortable troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA and Kubernetes controller/CRD-based platforms, and think about GPU infrastructure, and the tools that keep it reliable, as software to be engineered.

A product mindset applies: the on-call experience, the clarity of an alert, and the judgment built into an automated remediation are things you ship and iterate on.

Responsibilities

  • Operate the provisioning state machine in production: own the health of the host lifecycle pipeline, discovery, inference bring-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA, triaging stuck or failed state transitions at fleet scale and feeding real failure patterns back into how the states and transitions are designed.
  • Triage and extend automated self-healing: when the node-scanning and remediation platform misses something, a new failure mode, an InfiniBand issue in disaggregated prefill/decode serving, a GPU Xid variant, a hero-model or LoRA-specific fault, diagnose it live, drive the fix to production, and turn it into a new detection/remediation plugin so it's automatic the next time.
  • Own end-to-end reliability of the pipeline: hold the SLOs and error budgets for provisioning and fleet health, lead incident response when idempotency, retry, rollback, or drift assumptions break down in practice, and drive the systemic fix, not just the hotfix.
  • Partner with the inference/ML platform team from the production side: be the one who knows how real cluster topologies, interconnects, and scheduling constraints actually fail in the field, and feed those failure modes back as first-class requirements into the platform's abstractions.
  • Work alongside machine learning researchers, engineers, and product managers to bring our latest technologies into production, enabling advanced research through awesome engineering.

Requirements

  • Experience operating a provisioning or host-lifecycle pipeline in production, comfortable troubleshooting stuck or failed state transitions (discovery, bring-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA) at fleet scale, and translating real failure patterns back into improvements to the state machine’s design.

  • Familiarity with the operational realities of multi-tenant model serving (LoRA/adapter-based serving) and with running differentiated SLOs across model pools of different priority.
  • A demonstrated track record of eliminating operational toil through automation and tooling you built yourself, not just process or documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, reconciliation loops, and node-level health/remediation systems.
  • Comfort with event-driven architectures, backpressure/circuit-breaking design, and treating observability (metrics, logs, traces) as something built into a system, not added after an incident.

title: Staff Software Engineer - AI Compute, Together Cloud
description:
About the Role

Together AI is building the AI Native Cloud, an end-to-end platform for the full generative AI lifecycle, combining the fastest LLM inference engine with state-of-the-art GPU cloud infrastructure. The Together Cloud team builds the [Together GPU Clusters](https://www.together.ai/gpu-clusters) flagship IaaS product that provides high-performance, AI-ready GPU clusters through a self-serve cloud console, along with the virtualized infrastructure layer powering Together's inference, RL, and fine-tuning products.

As a Staff Software Engineer focusing on AI Compute in the Together Cloud org, you will set technical direction for and build major components of the next generation AI cloud platform – a highly available, global cloud infrastructure with cutting-edge virtualization of the latest ML hardware: GB300s/VRs, BlueField DPUs, InfiniBand and dual/quad-plane RoCEv2 fabrics. That virtualized computing platform powers our own SaaS products – inference, RL, and fine-tuning – and serves external cloud customers through self-serve offerings such as on-demand/reserved Kubernetes/Slurm clusters, across dozens of data centers and hundreds of thousands of GPUs.

This is an architect-and-build role. Fully automated bootstrapping of GPU data centers, high-performance virtualization of GPU compute and DC networking without compromising isolation or portability, and fault-tolerant decentralized control planes — you'll set the architecture for these across our global and in-DC services, and be a key owner of the hardest parts, in the code as well as the design. Your designs will span the IaaS layer of a greenfield Vera Rubin data center up to the global management plane that schedules capacity across all of them. At this level the job is as much leverage as code: the standards you set and the engineers you grow decide how fast the rest of Together Cloud ships.

Responsibilities

  • Own the GPU and network virtualization stack: the hypervisor, kernel, and SDN work that keeps GPU compute and DC networking high-performance, portable, and strongly isolated across heterogeneous hardware.
  • Own the in-DC IaaS layer: architect and roadmap the services, Kubernetes operators, and libraries that provision and manage compute, storage, and networks in our data centers — VMs, parallel filesystems, VPCs, and InfiniBand partitions; lead its build-out for a new Vera Rubin data center with thousands of GPUs, from hardware bring-up to customer-facing API.
  • Design the GPU scheduling and global management plane: the distributed control plane behind on-demand and reserved clusters across dozens of data centers, including the systems that scale per-cluster limits and automate the onboarding of new capacity.
  • Architect monitoring and automated remediation for fault tolerance: the strategy for automated detection, isolation, and recovery of failed nodes that keeps distributed pretraining and large-scale inference running through hardware failures.
  • Set technical direction across teams: lead design reviews, resolve cross-cutting architectural disagreements, unblock cross-team dependencies and integration risks, and define the standards other engineers build against — measured in cluster reliability, time-to-first-GPU on new capacity, and quality at scale.
  • Grow the team: mentor senior and junior engineers, deepen the team's expertise in virtualization, DC networking, and GPU infrastructure, and help raise the hiring bar for Together Cloud.
  • Set the engineering bar: create the testing frameworks, tools, and developer documentation that make our systems robust and usable by other teams, and shape the core, open-source Together AI platform.

To be successful you'll need to be deeply technical and an excellent communicator — expert software development fundamentals, deep systems knowledge and troubleshooting instincts, and the leadership and diplomacy skills to align teams that don't report to you. Much of this work starts ambiguous, and we expect you to define the scope yourself and drive it to production.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with expert-level proficiency in at least one backend language (Golang desired), writing high-performance, well-tested, production-quality code.
  • Track record of owning the architecture of large distributed systems from blank page to production at scale, including the judgment calls that could not be reversed cheaply.
  • Deep experience building and operating globally distributed, high-performance microservice architectures across one or more cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Expert systems knowledge across compute, networking, and storage — including concurrency, memory management, performant I/O, and scale at a global level.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership beyond your own commits: mentoring senior engineers, leading design reviews, and driving alignment across teams that do not report to you.
  • Excellent communication and diplomacy skills — able to write design docs that settle arguments, and to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience building and operating reliable, customer-facing production systems at scale, and owning the infrastructure automation (Terraform, Ansible), observability (Prometheus, Grafana), and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) that keep them healthy.

Preferred Qualifications (not must haves)

  • Deep Kubernetes internals experience, such as implementing non-trivial Kubernetes operators, device/storage/network plugins, custom schedulers, or patches to Kubernetes itself
  • Deep experience with VMs/hypervisors, such as QEMU/KVM, cloud-hypervisor, VFIO, virtio, PCIE passthrough, Kubevirt, SR-IOV
  • Deep experience with DC networking tech + solutions, such as VLAN, VXLAN, VPN, VPC, OVS/OVN
  • Experience with Cluster API or similar
  • Experience working on high-performance compute, networking, and/or storage
  • Experience virtualizing GPUs and/or InfiniBand
  • Experience building IaaS or PaaS systems at scale
  • Experience with DPUs/SmartNICs
  • GPU programming, NCCL, CUDA knowledge

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. title: Strategic Finance Senior Associate - Compute
description:
About the Role

As a Strategic Finance Senior Associate at Together, you will own the cost side of our data center build-outs. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Finance, Infrastructure, you will be the financial counterpart to our Infrastructure Strategy team: building and maintaining the cost base for every deployment, validating that build-outs are tracking to plan, and helping evaluate the economics of the sites we take on next.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the center of the largest capital decisions the company makes. The ideal candidate has done this before: inside a hyperscaler, neocloud, colocation provider, or data center developer, or covering data centers from the investing side, and pairs real infrastructure fluency with exceptional financial rigor.

Responsibilities

  • Own the cost base and cost forecast for Together's data center build-outs, spanning data center non-recurring costs, hardware capex across GPUs, networking, and storage, and ongoing operating costs
  • Validate that build-outs are tracking to plan: maintain budget-versus-actual against approved estimates, flag variances early with a clear read on the driver, and work with Infrastructure Strategy and Infrastructure Engineering to close them out
  • Maintain the all-in unit cost of owned capacity, on a dollars-per-GPU-hour basis by GPU type, as the source of truth used for pricing, margin, and capital allocation decisions
  • Partner with Infrastructure Strategy to evaluate new data center opportunities, building the economics for candidate sites including prepays, financing requirements, tax treatment and incentives, and total cost of ownership over the life of the site
  • Pressure-test hardware cost assumptions and surface savings opportunities with Infrastructure Engineering and Infrastructure Strategy, from equipment choices to storage sizing and cluster configuration trade-offs at different scales
  • Translate hardware delivery timelines and payment milestones maintained by Infrastructure Strategy into the cash forecast, and own tracking of prepays to hardware and data center suppliers, so that cash forecasting reflects real commitments
  • Build the reporting layer: dashboards and recurring processes that give leadership a current view of committed capital, spend to date, and forecast to complete, by site

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience with substantive exposure to data center or large-scale infrastructure capex, via one of two paths:
    • Operating side: finance, capex planning, or infrastructure strategy/FP&A at a hyperscaler, neocloud, colocation provider, data center developer, or another operator running large build-out programs
    • Investing side: investment banking, infrastructure investing, or project finance with a data center / digital infrastructure focus, ideally paired with time in-house at an operator
  • Working knowledge of the cost stack of a data center build: non-recurring costs, hardware capex (GPUs, networking, storage), power and cooling, and ongoing operating costs, and how each flows through COGS, depreciation, and cash
  • Exceptional financial modeling skills, including site-level TCO and scenario analysis, with the ability to distill a complex build into the handful of drivers that actually move the outcome
  • Demonstrated ownership of budget-versus-actual for large capital projects, with the discipline to catch variances early and the credibility to drive them to resolution
  • Comfort working directly with technical partners: able to hold a substantive conversation with infrastructure engineers, translate it into a cost number, and communicate the result clearly to non-technical and non-financial audiences
  • Exceptional business judgment and intuition, with the creativity and problem-solving instincts to tackle novel questions where there is no established playbook

title: Technical Writer Intern, Developer Experience (Summer 2027)
description:
About the Developer Experience team

The Developer Experience (DevX) team owns how developers learn and build on Together AI. We run the documentation site, API reference, quickstarts, cookbooks, and the tooling that keeps all of it accurate as the platform ships new models and features every week.

We treat docs as a product and as code. Content lives in Git, publishes through Mintlify, and stays in sync with the API through CI/CD automation built on GitHub Actions. We also write for two audiences at once: the human developer reading a guide, and the AI coding agent pulling our docs into its context window. That means a house style guide built for AI-assisted authoring, structured content agents can parse, and automated review passes that check drafts against our quality bar.

Role Overview

As a Technical Writer Intern on DevX, you will write, test, and ship documentation that thousands of developers use to build with open-weight models. You'll be paired with a DevX mentor and own significant projects end to end, from scoping through launch, with real users and real metrics at the finish line. 

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll run the code you document, call our APIs, and open pull requests against the docs repo from your first week.

Potential projects include:

  • Build a closed-to-open migration kit
  • Make a docs section agent-ready, and prove it
  • Generate the CLI reference from source
  • Write an evaluation design tutorial series

Responsibilities

  • Write clear, accurate guides, tutorials, and reference content for Together AI's inference, fine-tuning, and GPU cluster products.
  • Work with engineers, product managers, and researchers to understand new features well enough to explain them simply.
  • Use AI tools in your daily workflow, and help us improve how we use them for drafting, editorial review, and publishing.
  • Test every feature you document by running the code yourself, and file bugs when the product or the docs don't behave as expected.
  • Draft, review, and publish in a docs-as-code workflow: Git, pull requests, code review, and Mintlify.
  • Contribute to release notes and changelog entries as features launch.
  • Use page analytics, search data, and developer feedback to decide what to improve next.

Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program in Computer Science, Technical Communication, or a related field, graduating December 2027 or later.
  • Exceptional written communication: you can make a complex technical idea clear and approachable.
  • Working knowledge of at least one programming language (Python or TypeScript preferred) and comfort with Git source control.
  • Curiosity about how developers learn, and how AI is changing the way they do it.

Nice to have

  • Experience calling an LLM API or building a small project with AI tools.
  • Familiarity with Markdown/MDX, static site generators, or docs platforms like Mintlify or Docusaurus.
  • Experience with CI tools such as GitHub Actions.

Writing sample

Your application should include one or two writing samples, representing what you think is your own best work. The subject doesn’t have to be technical, or even nonfiction—though both are a plus! For example:

  • A technical blog post.
  • A README, tutorial, or contribution to open-source docs.
  • A research paper.
  • A personal essay.
  • A school newspaper submission.

Ads brings together Product and Engineering to build the products and systems that power Pinterest’s advertising platform across advertiser and Pinner experiences, enabling sustainable growth while protecting the quality and integrity of the product experience. This organization sits at the intersection of business strategy, scaled engineering systems, and product innovation, making it one of Pinterest’s most business-critical teams.

About the Role

We are hiring a Chief of Staff to the GM, Ads (Product, Engineering, Data Science) to help scale the organization, sharpen executive decision-making, and drive the operating agenda for this high-impact team. This Chief of Staff (CoS) will act as a senior strategic operator and trusted advisor who connects big-picture priorities with day-to-day execution, serving as a force multiplier for the GM and the broader leadership team.

 

The role is designed for a leader who can:

  • Operate as a thought partner to senior executives, with strong business and technical intuition
  • Build and run scalable operating mechanisms that drive clarity, accountability, and outcomes
  • Translate complex, ambiguous challenges into structured decisions, owners, and execution plans
  • Represent the organization in critical cross-functional forums with confidence and credibility across senior technical and business leaders

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a strategic partner and force multiplier to the GM, Ads and the broader Ads leadership team, helping them stay focused on the most important company and organizational priorities.
  • Own and continuously refine the executive operating agenda in partnership with leaders and TPMs, including strategic planning, goal setting, quarterly and annual business reviews, leadership offsites, and decision forums.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives that improve Ad’s execution across Product and Engineering, operating effectiveness, and business impact, stepping in to drive structure, alignment, and momentum where ambiguity is highest.
  • Translate ambiguous business, technical, and organizational problems into clear frameworks, options, recommendations, and decisions for the VP and leadership team.
  • Use data, qualitative insight, and organizational “listening” to identify risks, diagnose operating gaps, and proactively surface tradeoffs and implications to leadership.
  • Build alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, Data Science, Finance, Recruiting, People, and GTM partners, ensuring the Ads organization’s priorities, risks, and resource needs are well understood and integrated into company planning.
  • Design, implement, and evolve operating mechanisms that improve prioritization, decision quality, communication, and follow-through (for example, leadership cadences, decision logs, roadmap and investment reviews, and accountability trackers).
  • Support organizational planning and growth, including team structure, headcount and investment tradeoffs, leadership effectiveness, and operating-model evolution as the business and technology landscape changes.
  • Develop executive-level communications and narratives (for example, decision memos, business reviews, strategy updates, board and ET prep) that clarify strategy, progress, tradeoffs, and decisions for varied audiences.
  • Represent the Ads organization in critical forums with the Office of the CEO, other functional Chiefs of Staff, and cross-functional leadership groups, modeling the high standards of quality, efficiency, and operational rigor expected of the Office of the CEO and broader executive community.
  • Act as a culture carrier for Pinterest’s values, helping the organization Put Pinners First, Aim for Extraordinary, Create Belonging, Act as One, and Win or Learn in how it plans, executes, and communicates.
  • Collaborate with finance teams to manage budgets, optimize spending, and identify opportunities for efficiency and/or investment.
  • Understand, interface and work closely with recruiting and people orgs to evaluate and nurture healthy, cooperative engineering teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in strategic operations, business operations, program leadership, product operations, technical program management, consulting, finance, or a related role in complex, fast-moving organizations.
  • Experience operating as a trusted partner to senior executives or leadership teams, with a track record of shaping priorities, driving decisions, and landing complex, cross-functional programs.
  • Strong strategic judgment and systems thinking, with the ability to connect company and Ads priorities, organizational dynamics, technical realities, and execution constraints into a coherent plan.
  • Proven ability to lead high-impact initiatives from ambiguous problem definition through measurable outcomes, including establishing clear success metrics, governance, and accountability mechanisms.
  • Exceptional analytical skills; able to use both quantitative and qualitative data to diagnose issues, frame options, and influence decisions with clear, structured recommendations.
  • Outstanding executive communication skills, including the ability to craft concise narratives, decision memos, business reviews, and leadership communications for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, build trust quickly, and drive alignment across senior stakeholders with competing priorities and perspectives.
  • Experience designing and scaling operating mechanisms, planning processes, or organizational systems that improve focus, execution, and cross-functional alignment.
  • High integrity, discretion, and judgment; comfortable operating with access to sensitive information and navigating nuanced people, organizational, and business situations.
  • Comfort working at the intersection of technical, product, and business environments; you do not need to be the deepest technical expert, but you must be able to engage credibly with senior engineering and product leaders.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience partnering directly with Engineering, Product, or other technical executive teams as a Chief of Staff, strategic advisor, or senior TPM/strategic operations leader.
  • Experience in advertising, marketplace, platform, infrastructure, or other scaled technology environments where monetization, reliability, and user experience must be balanced thoughtfully.
  • Experience with organizational design, headcount planning, business planning, or executive-level operating rhythms (for example, OKR cycles, QBRs, investment reviews, or board/ET prep).
  • Experience partnering with Finance, Recruiting, People, or GTM teams on business-critical initiatives that span strategy, operations, talent, and culture.

As a Lead Client Partner at Pinterest, you will serve as a strategic visionary for top-tier enterprise travel clients, cultivating trusted relationships through deep expertise in full funnel advertising. You will independently engage assigned customer accounts to promote Pinterest’s products and develop lower-funnel strategies that drive measurable business outcomes, including traffic, sales, conversion, and customer retention.

By leveraging a nuanced understanding of retail businesses, retail media ecosystems, and client growth priorities, you will meet performance targets, develop new business, expand customer relationships, and resolve specific customer issues. You will guide clients in using Pinterest to turn inspiration into action for millions of Pinners, while building strategic alliances internally and externally. Success in this role depends on your ability to drive substantial revenue growth and a long-term vision for client success in a collaborative, dynamic environment.

What you'll do

Strategic Vision and Partnership Building

  • Develop and execute full-funnel sales strategies for top-tier Retail clients, with a particular focus on lower-funnel outcomes including conversion, sales, and retention.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships across client and agency stakeholders, including C-suite, Investment, Strategy, Retail Media, Ecommerce, and Activation teams. Organize key educational summits, strategy sessions, and QBRs.
  • Build and execute a strategic business plan to drive revenue growth on Pinterest. Secure buy-in from key stakeholders internally and externally, drive accountability through influence, deliver year-over-year growth, and spearhead annual deal conversations.
  • Demonstrate executive presence, leadership, and influence by understanding the ins and outs of client businesses, including retail trends, headwinds and tailwinds, business goals, ecommerce priorities, and media KPIs. Challenge the status quo and do not take client directives at face value.

Product Expertise and Market Influence

  • Serve as a product expert, providing guidance on the digital and retail media ecosystem and Pinterest’s advertising offerings, with a focus on performance and lower-funnel solutions.
  • Develop tailored retail media and performance strategies that leverage industry insights to achieve business goals and drive adoption of Pinterest’s performance media solutions, including search, Shopping, and feed-based ads.
  • Stay at the forefront of retail, ecommerce, performance marketing, and measurement trends to identify opportunities and address partner needs.

Internal and External Collaboration

  • Spearhead negotiations and develop joint business plans that align to partner goals, maximize lower-funnel impact, and mobilize cross-functional teams to address complex challenges.
  • Drive business growth by analyzing partner goals and performance data, delivering data-driven insights, and crafting compelling narratives that guide successful retail media and performance strategies.

Champion Pinterest’s Value

  • Champion Pinterest’s value proposition by showcasing impactful lower-funnel and performance metrics, positioning Pinterest as a key driver of retail growth within advertisers’ media mix.
  • Proactively identify and communicate opportunities for incremental growth, working closely with clients to expand retail media and performance partnerships.

What we are looking for

  • Full-Funnel Advertising Expertise: Strong understanding of media and measurement solutions across brand, consideration, and conversion, with the ability to connect upper-funnel investment to lower-funnel performance.
  • Strong Consultative and Negotiation Skills: Proven track record of developing long-term partnerships and effectively negotiating annual partnership agreements, ensuring mutual satisfaction and driving high-value client engagements.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to think critically and analytically, leveraging retail, macroeconomic, and performance trends to translate learnings into actionable insights that propel revenue growth.
  • Goal- and Results-Oriented Approach: Demonstrated ability to consistently achieve revenue goals while balancing short- and long-term growth objectives. Brings a strategic, results-oriented approach to client and media management that drives sustainable success and mutually beneficial outcomes.
  • Excellent Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments while maintaining high standards of operational excellence, strategic thinking, and collaborative partnership.
  • Challenger Mindset: Willingness to challenge and remain persistent with key decision-makers. Client Partners continually evolve relationships with client, agency, retail media, ecommerce, and creative decision-makers; drive weekly accountability through action plans; and find creative solutions where product or capability gaps exist.
  • AI Enthusiast: Demonstrates strong curiosity for and practical application of AI to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and elevate client communications, presentations, and recommendations. Uses AI thoughtfully across account strategy and sales motions to uncover insights, sharpen strategic narratives, and show up as a strong, trusted advisor while maintaining sound judgment and a high bar for quality.

Pinterest is a company like no other. And this is a time like no other. We’ve spent the last decade building one of the world’s most beloved products, and we’re building one of the world’s most beloved brands to match. We’ve earned the right to tell bigger stories than ever before. That’s where you come in.

 

This is a rare ground-floor opportunity to build Pinterest’s EMEA creative department in London, as part of House of Creative. As our Lead Copywriter, you’ll concept and write the work that takes that brand further in the region, from campaign ideas and manifestos to taglines and social, with a particular emphasis on concepting and writing. You’ll work across consumer and B2B, partnering with Creative Leaders to reach Consumers, Creators and Advertisers with work that’s global and culturally sharp.

 

What you’ll do

  • Lead the development of compelling campaign ideas with art direction partners, taking early concepts through to their strongest 360° creative expression.
  • Write everything from campaign copy, manifestos and taglines to social captions, digital copy and other brand communications, making sure each piece supports the larger story.
  • Uplevel creative quality of work across the team in partnership with marketing - delivering both business results and international recognition for the Pinterest brand in the industry
  • Collaborate with creatives across disciplines—including design, photography, motion, video and editing—to make cohesive work across formats and markets.
  • Be a source of inspiration through your collaboration with art directors, designers, producers and marketing managers in creating work that has deep cultural resonance
  • Help evolve Pinterest’s voice and tone, and bring it to life across creative touchpoints. Present and sell the thinking behind your work to key stakeholders, creative directors and team members. Including partnering with the US creative team to adapt flagship campaigns for EMEA markets when needed.
  • Bring depth to conceptual writing
  • Use AI thoughtfully to explore more ideas faster and sharpen your writing, while holding the pen and owning the craft, accuracy and quality of the final work.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • A minimum of 8 years of experience in copywriting or brand writing, including a minimum of 3 years leading creative work or mentoring others
  • A book of work with outstanding writing and concepts across brands and mediums, including integrated campaigns and both consumer and B2B work

The Responsible AI team is part of the Advanced Technologies Group (ATG), Pinterest’s advanced machine learning team. ATG’s goal is to keep Pinterest at the forefront of machine learning technology across multiple use cases including recommendations, ranking, content understanding, and more. It is an applied team that works horizontally across the company on state of the art AI and ML and works on directly bringing that technology to the product in collaboration with product engineering teams. The team also publishes its work in applied research conferences, but the main goal of the team is to have a direct impact on business metrics.

At Pinterest our goal is to inspire pinners (our users) to live the life they love. The product is powered by state of the art ML algorithms which are used to understand both the billions of visually rich items on the platform and the interests of our 535M+ monthly active users and recommend inspiring personalized content to them. What this means is that ML at Pinterest is not only multi-modal utilizing image, text, and graph signals as input, but it needs to operate at a very large scale and often in a real time interactive user experience.

Pinterest is known for being a positive and inspirational place on the internet and we believe that inspiration begins with representation and belonging. The Responsible AI team is a horizontal team that collaborates across the company on various initiatives. These range from Generative AI alignment, evaluation, and mitigations - ensuring these models are safe, bias-free, and aligned with Pinterest’s vision and policies - to championing ML Fairness and developing user-facing features that enhance our product for all users. This includes launching groundbreaking features such as user-controllable skin tone, hair pattern search refinements, and more recently, body type.

You’ll help shape forward-thinking projects, develop advanced ML approaches rooted in fairness and equitability, and pioneer responsible AI safeguards for emerging technologies. By joining this team, you’ll make a lasting impact on our Pinners, our business, and the evolution of ethical AI at Pinterest.

 

What you'll do:

  • execute on projects in the responsible AI frontier, to identify, avoid, and mitigate bias across a wide range of ML applications at Pinterest including generative AI. 
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams (trust and safety, user modeling, content understanding,) to leverage their platforms and signals and work with them to collaborate on the adoption and evaluation of Responsible AI practices and ML Fairness tooling across Pinterest.

  • Work with the team and senior leaders at the company to define and drive technical strategy in this area.

 

What we're looking for:

  • Extensive, real-world experience applying advanced ML methods to production systems, with a strong track record in responsible technology - spanning fairness, ethics, and broader societal considerations.
  • Deep familiarity with cutting-edge ML architectures (e.g., transformer-based models, 2-tower architectures, LLMs) and their applications in large-scale Search and Recommender Systems.
  • Proven ability to measure, deploy, and refine fairness interventions and broader Responsible AI solutions at scale, bridging state-of-the-art research with tangible product impact.
  • 2+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large-scale ML-driven user-facing products
  • Masters or PhD in Comp Sci or related fields
  • Nice to have:

    • Familiarity with LLM-powered productivity tools for documentation search, experiment analysis, SQL/data exploration, and engineering workflow acceleration
    • Expertise in scalable realtime systems that process stream data

By building foundation ML models that utilize our extensive knowledge graph and billions of Pins, we aim to significantly enhance the core Pinterest product.

You will join the core visual pod, a collaborative group of approximately six engineers and a product prototyping team, to create specialized evaluation benchmarks and contribute to the broader research community.

What you’ll do:

  • Prototype new model architectures for Pinterest VLMs. We’re looking for hands-on experience working with finetuning open-source LLM models and improve their visual perception and tool using capabilities.
  • Develop new evaluation benchmarks that tailors to vision-centric capabilities such as fashion style recommendations.
  • Read research papers, participate in group discussions, and help brainstorm our overall visual generative strategy at the company.
  • Help with collection of relevant visual training data for Pinterest Canvas, particularly to conduct RLHF, targeted fine-tuning, etc.
  • Publish and publicize your work via conferences, paper submissions, blog posts, etc. 


What we’re looking for:

  • Research engineers and scientists who have experience working with generative computer vision models, preferably various forms of visual encoders and LLMs.
  • 2+ years of industry computer vision experience.
  • M.S. or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related areas.


Nice to Have:

  • Publications at top ML conferences.
  • Experience using Cursor, Copilot, Codex, or similar AI coding assistants for development, debugging, testing, and refactoring.

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager who can drive the team’s technical direction, lead the team in building scalable content understanding systems, and make an impact on core Pinterest user and business outcomes.

What will you be doing:

  • Lead, mentor and grow a team of engineers and applied scientists in developing foundational content understanding signals, infrastructure and systems that are integral to key Pinterest products across Discovery, Search, Growth, and Ads.

Partner closely with product, data science, and downstream engineering teams to ensure these signals drive meaningful impact across Pinterest.
  • Manage project execution and stakeholder communication, including roadmap planning, technical decision-making, risk mitigation, and progress updates to achieve business goals.

    • How to leverage the latest VLM and LLM technologies to understand the full semantic richness of Pinterest content and generate high-quality signals with strong precision, recall and coverage across multiple locales?
    • How to build reusable foundational layers such as captions, summaries and semantic descriptors that can power multiple downstream use cases efficiently and at low infra cost?
    • How to improve inference throughput, freshness and serving efficiency so that content understanding signals can keep up with millions of new Pins and evolving content every day?
    • How to measure and improve the downstream impact of content understanding signals on relevance, personalization, engagement and ads performance across different surfaces?

  • Masters degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent work experience
  • Publication at top machine learning and data mining conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, KDD, SIGIR)
  • Experience with:
    • Large scale distributed training and inference of LLM and VLM models.
    • Distributed tooling for ML data pipelines, e.g. Hadoop, Spark.
    • Leading ambiguous ML projects to build, apply and improve GenAI models for content understanding and recommendation systems.
  • Proven technical leadership across both ML and Data systems, with experience setting direction for multi-quarter roadmaps that span modeling, data pipelines, and productionization, and aligning stakeholders on priorities, trade-offs, and execution plans.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills, building strong partnerships with product, data science, and partner ML teams to clarify ambiguous problem spaces, co-create solutions, and drive consensus with senior stakeholders.

Pinterest is looking for a Performance Solutions Lead. This role is responsible for enabling advertisers and sellers to drive success on the Pinterest platform, through the adoption of priority products and the development of new / innovative best practices. The Performance Solutions Lead will closely partner with cross-functional leadership in sales, product, and engineering. This is a multi-faceted, fast-paced job in a start-up environment so flexibility, a data-driven mindset, a strong work ethic, and a good sense of humor are a must. The right candidate will be a strategic thought leader who is driven by learning and solving ambiguous problems, yet be able to be hands on to troubleshoot technical issues that is a revenue blocker to lower funnel revenue. 

The Performance Solutions team sits within the GTM Operations and Strategy organization. Performance Solutions delivers through strategic guidance, operational excellence and technical expertise to improve the effectiveness of advertising campaigns resulting in increased client ROI. We work to understand, innovate, and scale cross-functional workflows. We are responsible for measuring process impact, making our business more efficient with consistent execution while embarking on building the next generation of data-driven best practices.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Become an expert at Pinterest campaign best practices and ads manager, enabling yourself to be your regions go to resource for performance related opportunities
  • Be the technical contact for sales to help activate lower funnel campaigns (ex. eCommerce, performance focused), inclusive of product, auction and implementation knowledge.
  • Enable and mobilize sellers to pitch new performance products alongside campaign strategy at scale, with a focus on products that involves performance automation
  • Analyze large amounts of ads manager and/or client MSOT data to strategize for the next performance opportunity 
  • Be the performance guru to support pre-GA performance products on ensuring successful alpha and beta tests
  • Understand complex processes and products, distilling them down into a digestible format for a less technical audience
  • Lead participate in global SME working groups to support pre-GA performance products and new technical integrations 
  • Be the go-to person for leadership in your market when it comes to support on account planning, shopping strategy for key accounts, and account/vertical revenue growth driven by shopping/lower funnel performance 
  • Provide strategic thought leadership top tier clients to help enable new performance products and creating A/B testing learning agendas 
  • Identify key issues facing our clients and advertisers, and develop proposed solutions on how Pinterest should solve them through systems, processes and / or people
  • Work with your region to adapt best practices to fit the market you are supporting, and relay that feedback to internal and external stakeholders

 

What we’re looking for:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience within digital marketing, ad tech and ad operations
  • 5+ years of both client facing and hands-on experience in platform relating to ad tech, ad ops, and/or campaign management
  • 5+ years in performance marketing either at a tech vendor, agency, or in-house client side
  • Experience selling performance products and/or getting in-house buy-in adopt a performance product 
  • Experience with tagging and tracking QA and support, and working with HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
  • Expertise in digital advertising and media sales including campaign optimization, analytical problem solving, sales facing experience, and product/platform knowledge
  • Technical foundation with relevant experience in Search/Shopping/Display/Social advertising technologies
  • Working knowledge of API implementation and benefits (ex. Conversion API)
  • Expert knowledge of web analytics (ex. GA4), MMP (ex. AppsFlyer) and e-commerce strategies to drive retail business (but not excluding other priority verticals as we adapt to the market)
  • A structured and detail-oriented thinker. You’re as comfortable solving conceptual problems and creating frameworks to refine a team’s thinking as you are getting into the weeds to understand how things work.
  • Strong communication skills. You can move seamlessly between conversing with engineers or frontline sales employees and lead presentations with senior leads.
  • Fluency in business Mandarin and English is a must for business purpose.
  • An individual that thrives in a fast-moving environment and is independently capable of seeking information, corralling resources, and delivering results without waiting for direction.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent relevant experience.

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

  • We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including Product, Engineering, Data, Security, Marketing, and other Legal teams—to embed privacy-by-design into the product lifecycle, guide high-impact launches, and help balance business goals with privacy compliance obligations. You’ll have the opportunity to shape and execute scalable privacy processes, including leading privacy risk assessments and supporting privacy governance across EU-facing products and features.

Our new progressive work model is called PinFlex, a term that’s uniquely Pinterest to describe our flexible approach to living and working. Visit our PinFlex landing page to learn more.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Provide end-to-end EU privacy product counseling for new products and feature launches, from early design through launch and iteration.
  • Advise on key GDPR, ePrivacy, DSA, EU AI Act topics, including lawful bases, transparency, consent and choice design, profiling/personalization considerations, data minimization, retention, and data subject rights implications.
  • Lead and support privacy risk assessments (including DPIAs, where applicable), driving mitigations and documenting decisions in partnership with cross-functional teams.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to operationalise privacy-by-design and scalable privacy controls (e.g., consent enforcement, data access controls, retention/deletion approaches).
  • Provide guidance on data sharing and vendor/partner arrangements impacting EU processing, including supporting negotiation of privacy terms and data protection addenda as needed.
  • Advise on international data transfers for EU data flows, partnering with internal stakeholders and outside counsel where appropriate to support compliant transfer mechanisms and risk mitigations.
  • Develop and improve scalable privacy workflows, templates, and playbooks to enable consistent, efficient privacy review across multiple teams and roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners and Legal colleagues to address privacy issues that arise from incidents, complaints, or escalations, and help drive durable process improvements.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools thoughtfully and responsibly to improve the efficiency and consistency of privacy counseling and program workflows, while maintaining appropriate legal oversight and quality control.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Qualified to practice law in the jurisdiction where you reside (or equivalent EU qualification).
  • Significant post-qualification legal experience in privacy, with substantial experience counseling on EU privacy law (including GDPR; ePrivacy knowledge strongly preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience providing product counseling in a fast-paced environment, with the ability to translate legal requirements into clear, practical guidance for Legal, Product and Engineering teams.
  • Experience leading or materially supporting DPIAs/privacy risk assessments, and driving cross-functional mitigations to enable launches while managing risk.
  • Strong understanding of how modern products handle data (e.g., data flows, analytics, SDKs/APIs, tracking/measurement concepts) sufficient to counsel effectively on privacy-by-design.
  • Excellent judgment and integrity, with strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with an ability to drive alignment across teams in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities with independence, sound judgment, and attention to detail.
  • Eagerness to learn, strong ownership, and a flexible, collaborative approach to problem-solving.

In some instances, partner with research agencies to commission and take to market custom research.

  • Experience building high-quality presentations in Google Slides; aptitude with data visualization or design is a plus
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to use data storytelling to craft engaging and actionable insights for a variety of professional audiences; experience presenting insights to audiences large and small
  • Track record of operating independently, demonstrating data-backed storytelling skills, being detail-oriented, and delivering results in a highly organized yet engaging manner
  • Experience in the digital space required; social media platforms, ad agencies, or research agencies a plus
  • Experience working quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced tech environment

About Pinterest

Millions of people across the world come to Pinterest to find new ideas every day. It’s where they get inspiration, dream about new possibilities and plan for what matters most. Our mission is to help those people find their inspiration and create a life they love. As a Pinterest employee, you’ll be challenged to take on work that upholds this mission and pushes Pinterest forward. You’ll grow as a person and leader in your field, all the while helping users make their lives better in the positive corner of the internet.

As Senior Privacy Counsel (EU), you will provide strategic, product-focused privacy counseling to help Pinterest design, build, and scale products in compliance with EU privacy requirements (including GDPR and ePrivacy). In this role, you’ll partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including Product, Engineering, Data, Security, Marketing, and other Legal teams—to embed privacy-by-design into the product lifecycle, guide high-impact launches, and help balance business goals with privacy compliance obligations. You’ll have the opportunity to shape and execute scalable privacy processes, including leading privacy risk assessments and supporting privacy governance across EU-facing products and features.

Our new progressive work model is called PinFlex, a term that’s uniquely Pinterest to describe our flexible approach to living and working. Visit our PinFlex landing page to learn more.

What you’ll do:

  • Provide end-to-end privacy counseling, including to the Trust & Safety and Product teams on products, features, tools, and operations, from early design through launch and iteration. 
  • Advise on global privacy and data protection issues arising in the Trust & Safety context, including platform abuse prevention, content moderation, user reporting, enforcement operations, account integrity, age assurance, identity-related signals, automated decision-making, and sensitive data handling. 
  • Counsel on key legal and regulatory privacy and privacy adjacent frameworks including EU GDPR, ePrivacy, UK GDPR, CCPA, UK Children’s Code, California AADC, and other global privacy laws, with familiarity in adjacent issues involving online safety, transparency, and accountability. 
  • Lead and support privacy risk assessments, including DPIAs where applicable, and drive practical mitigations in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. 
  • Partner closely with Trust & Safety, Product, Engineering, Security, Regulatory, and other Legal teams to operationalize privacy-by-design in systems, workflows, and investigations. 
  • Support development of scalable governance frameworks, review processes, templates, and playbooks to enable efficient and consistent privacy review. 
  • Provide guidance on third-party and vendor arrangements, including privacy terms, data protection requirements, and data sharing considerations. 
  • Advise on international data transfers for cross-border data flows, partnering with internal stakeholders and outside counsel where appropriate to support compliant transfer mechanisms and risk mitigations.
  • Develop and improve scalable privacy workflows, templates, and playbooks to enable consistent, efficient privacy review across multiple teams and roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners and Legal colleagues to address privacy issues that arise from incidents, complaints, or escalations, regulatory inquiries, and internal investigations, and help drive durable process improvements.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools thoughtfully and responsibly to improve the efficiency and consistency of privacy counseling and program workflows, while maintaining appropriate legal oversight and quality control.

What we’re looking for:

  • Qualified to practice law in the jurisdiction where you reside with a minimum of 10 years of experience.
  • Demonstrated experience providing privacy counseling in a fast-paced environment to Trust & Safety and Product teams, with the ability to translate legal requirements into clear, practical guidance for business, product, and technical teams. 
  • Experience leading or materially supporting DPIAs/privacy risk assessments, and driving cross-functional mitigations to enable launches while managing risk.
  • Experience with privacy product counseling on ads in the tech sector, as well as advising on commercial matters, including reviewing, drafting, and negotiating data processing agreements (DPAs) and advising on related data protection terms, a significant plus.

Within Pinterest, the Pinterest Labs organization focuses on applied ML research and development. Labs focuses on a broad variety of AI/ML initiatives, such as core computer vision, multimodal representation learning, heterogeneous graph neural networks, generative modeling, recommender systems, etc. This is the group that develops foundation ML models that fully leverage the tens of billions of Pins and the associated knowledge graph to improve the core product.

We are currently hiring for the visual modeling team in Labs, which focuses on developing Pinterest Canvas. Canvas is a foundation text-to-image model developed internally for helping various visualization, inpainting, and outpainting products. In this role, you’ll get to work with Pinterest’s rich visual-text dataset to build large-scale generative models which are continuously being shipped to production to power visualization features. The core Canvas pod is a small group (~6 engineers along with a product prototyping team) inside of Labs, allowing for deep collaboration. For example, engineers working on the Canvas project also participate in the development of our core multimodal text & image embeddings, as these are in turn used to condition the model in unique ways.

What you’ll do:

  • Prototype new model architectures for Pinterest Canvas, our internal text-to-image generative model. We’re looking for hands-on experience working with diffusion text-to-image models and independent model implementation skills.
  • Read research papers, participate in group discussions, and help brainstorm our overall visual generative strategy at the company.
  • Help with collection of relevant visual training data for Pinterest Canvas, particularly to conduct RLHF, targeted fine-tuning, etc.
  • Publish and publicize your work via conferences, paper submissions, blog posts, etc. 
  • Mentor more junior researchers or research interns within the Pinterest Labs organization.


What we’re looking for:

  • Research engineers and scientists who have experience working with generative computer vision models, preferably various forms of diffusion models.
  • 5+ years of industry computer vision experience.
  • M.S. or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related areas.

Nice to Have:

  • Publications at top ML conferences.
  • Experience using Cursor, Copilot, Codex, or similar AI coding assistants for development, debugging, testing, and refactoring.
  • Familiarity with LLM-powered productivity tools for documentation search, experiment analysis, SQL/data exploration, and engineering workflow acceleration.

In this role you’ll bring deep qual and mixed methods experience (as needed) to design, execute and communicate strategic research to senior stakeholders in the Ads org and beyond. You’ll shape strategy by partnering with Product, Design, and Engineering and presenting insights and written POVs directly to senior leadership. You’ll also help us decide where sustained research investment is needed, set direction for large cross-team research efforts, and mentor other researchers to raise the bar for qualitative craft. In this role, you’ll have ownership of a broad problem space, autonomy to set and execute your research agenda, and real influence over the ads roadmap and the holistic Pinner experience.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Lead high-impact qualitative research in our most strategic ads areas: Embed in one or two high-priority problem spaces, such as Ads Integrity, and own the full research cycle from discovery through execution, delivery, and influence on product decisions.
  • Uncover and represent complex advertiser and user problems: Identify the deep, ambiguous customer needs that cut across the ads product, and translate them into clear opportunities for the business.
  • Shape the research agenda: Work with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and quantitative UX Research to scope and prioritize the questions that matter most for the areas you support, and independently identify where research can have the greatest impact.
  • Choose the right method for the question: Plan, field, and synthesize research using the full range of qualitative methods, and partner with Data Science and quantitative researchers on mixed-methods studies that combine depth with scale.
  • Influence strategy and roadmap: Partner with PMs and Designers to deliver informed, actionable recommendations, and communicate insights directly to leadership to help shape product direction. Author written POVs and cross-study syntheses that connect findings into a bigger picture.
  • Assess where sustained research investment is needed: Evaluate whether an area warrants a long-term research presence, and make the case to leadership for where to invest.
  • Use AI to amplify your craft:. Bring creativity to how you apply AI tools to research workflows and to how you land learnings, making cross-functional collaboration faster and more effective.
  • Provide vision and direction for large collaborative efforts: Lead cross-team research initiatives across the ads organization (and as needed across ads and consumer orgs), setting direction and aligning partners around a shared point of view.
  • Mentor and raise the bar: Coach and develop other researchers, and elevate qualitative craft across the team.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in qualitative or mixed-methods user research, with a track record of leading research at a staff or senior staff level in a product organization, ideally in ads, marketplaces, or B2B/B2C platforms.
  • Deep expertise across the qualitative toolkit. Fluency in interviews, ethnography, diary studies, usability testing, concept testing, and other methods, with sound judgment about which approach best fits the question, timeline, and decision at hand.
  • Experience in mixed-methods research. Demonstrated success partnering with Data Science and quantitative UX Research to combine qualitative depth with quantitative scale, and to triangulate findings across data sources.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy and roadmap supported by strong storytelling and recommendations that can drive action
  • Strong executive communication skills and comfort presenting insights, written POVs, and recommendations to senior leaders (Sr. Directors +) and cross-functional partners, and tailoring the message to the audience.
  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity and take an unstructured, high-urgency problem space, define the right questions, and build a learning agenda with minimal direction.
  • Strong strategic judgment and decision quality to assess where research will have the greatest impact, prioritize accordingly, and make a clear case for where sustained investment is (or isn’t) warranted.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with PMs, Designers, Engineers, Data Scientists, and quantitative researchers, and to build trust and credibility across disciplines.
  • Experience leading large, collaborative research efforts with proven ability to set vision and direction across teams, align stakeholders around a shared point of view, and drive complex initiatives to completion.
  • Curiosity and creativity in using AI tools. Enthusiasm for applying AI to research workflows, from synthesis to storytelling, to work faster and land insights in more compelling ways. Working knowledge of standard AI based research tools and capabilities preferred.

The Data Product Platform is mission-critical to accelerating data-driven decision-making at Pinterest on the foundation of 100s of thousands of tables and an exadata-scale data warehouse. We strive to provide effortless, efficient, and reliable data products and platforms that power the entire company. We achieve this by investing in three core areas:

  1. Data Warehouse: Building and managing the foundational data warehouses that enable key analyses across both our core engagement and monetization products.
  2. Analytical Velocity: Creating powerful analytical tools that empower internal data users to leverage our vast data assets and capable infrastructure effectively.
  3. Data Governance: Defining and implementing the data governance policies and tools necessary to ensure the responsible, efficient and compliant storage and handling of all data.

We are seeking a Sr. Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership and direction across these three pillars. In this role, you will be instrumental in architecting and driving solutions that handle increasing data volume, navigate business complexity, accelerate analytical velocity, and build the foundation for our next generation of AI analytics products. If you are passionate about building world-class data ecosystems at massive scale, we invite you to lead our efforts.

What you’ll do: 

  • Spearhead the definition and design of Pinterest's data warehouse architecture, storage, governance, and usage.
  • Set the strategic direction for world-class data analytics tools, including experimentation platforms, ad hoc analysis systems, data visualization, data pipeline authoring, and AI-assisted data analytics capabilities.
  • Define, design, and drive the adoption of comprehensive data governance policies and tooling to ensure data quality, promote responsible data handling, and maximize efficiency.
  • Lead ambiguous, highly challenging, and cross-functional initiatives across the data ecosystem, expertly managing trade-offs among unique requirements and constraints (e.g., usability, efficiency, and compliance) to deliver a cohesive user experience.
  • Drive measurable adoption and significant business impact across the entire product portfolio through platform and tooling initiatives.
  • Mentor and elevate the technical bar for engineers, providing leadership on complex technical design, execution strategies, and critical trade-off decisions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams to understand user needs, drive alignment and drive progress.

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years of relevant industry experience with large scale data warehouses, data tools and platforms. 
  • 5+ years experience building data warehouses and tools around the data ecosystem with technologies such as Spark, Trino, Flink, Airflow, Querybook, Superset, DataHub, etc.
  • Ability to work with cross-functional partners across multiple organizations.
  • Hands-on experience building tools and data pipelines leveraging AI coding tools, e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.
  • Hands-on experience building AI tools and platforms to accelerate data pipeline authoring, data analytics and engineering productivity.

In this role, you’ll lead LLM-first, evaluation-driven initiatives—near-term focused on agentic workflows, measurement, and operational rigor that strengthen Merchant Integrity and Business Integrity. Pinterest is looking for a thoughtful, highly skilled Staff Motion Designer to join the Design Innovation team. You will define and evolve the motion design language that brings clarity, coherence, and delight to Pinterest across surfaces and flagship features. This is a hands-on, horizontal role for a rare blend of motion craft leader, systems thinker, and design technologist. You will establish reusable motion principles, patterns, tokens, and implementation guidance within the design system; partner directly with product and engineering teams to solve challenging interaction problems; and build tools and prototypes that make it easier to explore and ship exceptional motion at scale. Your impact will extend from the details of a single interaction to the cohesive experience of Pinterest as a whole.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve Pinterest’s motion design language – principles, interaction and transition patterns, timing and tokens, specifications, and guidance – so motion is intentional, coherent, accessible, and reusable across the product ecosystem.
  • Lead motion direction for flagship and AI-forward experiences, using motion to clarify state, cause and effect, hierarchy, feedback, progress, and system responsiveness.
  • Partner horizontally with product designers, engineers, product managers, researchers, and content designers to connect individual feature work to a shared motion strategy and raise the quality of shipped experiences.
  • Turn high-craft explorations into scalable design system contributions that reduce ad hoc implementation, improve consistency, and enable teams to move faster with confidence.
  • Rapidly prototype and validate motion ideas using the right medium – motion studies, design tools, code, AI-enabled tools, or custom prototypes – to create shared understanding and accelerate decisions.
  • Work closely with engineering throughout implementation to solve technically ambitious animation challenges while balancing performance, platform conventions, accessibility, and maintainability.
  • Develop or enable lightweight tools, templates, and workflows that help designers explore visual and motion ideas quickly and help engineering teams build sophisticated animations reliably.
  • Stay at the leading edge of AI-enabled motion and visual-creation tools, applying them strategically to improve ideation, prototyping, and production while maintaining critical thinking, quality validation, and ownership of final outcomes.
  • Conduct motion quality reviews, give actionable feedback on designs and implementations, and mentor designers in motion principles, systems thinking, prototype craft, and productive engineering partnership.
  • Clearly articulate the rationale, tradeoffs, and user impact behind motion decisions to teams, leaders, and executives; build alignment around a high bar for motion craft and system quality.

 

What we’re looking for

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in motion design, product design, interaction design, or a closely related discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional motion craft in shipped digital products or platforms.
  • A staff/principal-level track record of influencing horizontally across teams, shaping a product or design-system direction, and raising quality without relying on formal authority.
  • Deep command of motion and interaction design principles, including timing, choreography, easing, spring behavior, feedback, and transitions – and strong judgment about when motion improves usability, comprehension, emotion, and trust.
  • Experience creating or materially evolving scalable motion systems, such as principles, token sets, pattern libraries, documentation, tooling, and governance that teams can adopt across products and platforms.

Billions of dollars flow through Retail Media Networks (RMNs) onto advertising platforms like Pinterest every year, but it can be a sub-par experience for the RMN, the brand advertiser, and for Pinterest.  The RMN’s fees are hidden, campaign setup and management is manual and slow, and Pinterest gets left out of most of the relationship.  Pinterest Media Network Connect (PMNC) is Pinterest’s solution to this problem, with complete transparency and self-service capabilities.  Pinterest was the first to do this style of solution to the problem, and it is being copied by larger adverting platforms as a result, so we know we’re on the right path.

 

But changing the retail media network business is not enough.  We have ambitions to support a fully transparent, fully self-service audience marketplace, where anyone can transact with anyone else to empower their campaigns with audiences that enhance their performance and reach.  

 

You, as the lead for PMNC and audience marketplace, will grow our RMN offerings and build the audience marketplace business from the ground up.  Leading these products involves collaborating with a dynamic, motivated, and expert team of cross functional partners to build brand new systems, develop relationships with partners, automate processes, and champion our solutions internally.  Your success will depend on leading the company through significant process changes, having deep empathy for our partners and advertisers, partnering with many stakeholders internally and externally.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Grow and lead our PMNC business to a billion+ dollars of revenue.
  • Build a new audience marketplace offering from scratch into an industry-leading solution.
  • Lead product vision, strategy, technical development, and execution for PMNC and our audience marketplace business.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the business’s workflows, and automate what will make the business run better and faster.
  • Design and build billing user interfaces – both internal and external – for delightful experiences.
  • Translate insights into clear product requirements and collaborate with engineering, design, data analytics, marketing, research, and other product teams to drive measurable impact.  
  • Communicate your strategy internally to ensure alignment, secure resources, and champion the roadmap’s vision. 
  • Leverage AI to turbo-charge your own work, from writing to design to prototyping, and more.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Experience with retail media network solutions, audience marketplaces is a big plus.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills.  
  • Proven ability to shepherd large cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.  
  • Strong analytical mindset, using data to guide decisions and optimize workflows.  
  • Extreme attention to detail and meticulous design sense.
  • Track record of rapidly delivering user-focused solutions in a cross-functional setting.
  • Location around SF, NYC, or Palo Alto.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience

AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize serves a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like Booking.com, Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an AI Application Engineer who thrives on solving hard problems with code. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to work at the cutting edge of generative AI in a high-impact role with autonomy and ownership. While we are a remote-first company, the nature of this role requires candidates to be based in the Singapore area.

What You’ll Do

  • Debug and fix issues in our platform (and ship PRs with your fixes).
  • Build internal tools and copilots powered by generative AI to supercharge our team.
  • Rapidly prototype proof-of-concepts for customer use cases.
  • Work across Engineering, Product, and Solutions to unblock customers and push the boundaries of AI adoption.

What We’re Looking For

  • You have 2-5 years of experience in software.
  • Strong in Python and Golang; comfortable shipping fixes in production systems.
  • Hands-on with generative AI (LLM APIs, frameworks, building copilots or automations)
  • Hands-on with OpenTelemetry and deep familiarity with distributed tracing concepts.
  • Familiarity with AI frameworks (CrewAI, Langchain, Langgraph, DiFy, LiteLLM, etc).
  • Familiarity or eagerness to learn JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Great debugger, creative problem solver, and fast learner.
  • Independent and resourceful. You create solutions, not dependencies.

Bonus Points (but not required!)

  • Experience in a customer-facing role
  • Built copilots, plugins, or custom GenAI-powered applications.
  • Open-sourced or contributed PRs to real codebases.
  • Startup or fast-moving environment experience.

You’ll play a pivotal role in driving adoption, shaping product use cases, and ensuring our customers succeed in leveraging AI to achieve real-world impact.  This role is a blend of solutions consulting, customer engagement, and AI product feedback. You’ll own the customer lifecycle end to end: identifying the business problem, defining what success looks like with their stakeholders, shaping how Arize fits their architecture, and driving adoption through renewal and expansion. You’ll also feed what you learn back into the product, so solutions you build for one customer become repeatable for the next.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a portfolio of commerical/digital native accounts: account plans, regular touchpoints, usage monitoring, QBRs, and renewals
  • Conduct discovery with customer’s AI/ML teams to understand their goals, share the Arize vision, demonstrate product capabilities, and propose tailored solutions.

  • Run QBRs to demonstrate account value, identify areas of opportunity, and strengthen customer partnerships.
  • Proactively monitor product usage across your accounts to further gauge account health
  • Engage customer executives as champions to drive adoption beyond the initial team
  • Lead onboarding workshops and training on new functionality
  • Work with Account Management and Sales to convert successful pilots into org-wide deployments
  • Advocate for customer needs with product and engineering, and turn one-off solutions into standardized offerings

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years in customer success, solutions consulting, technical account management, or technical consulting at a tech company
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML workflows or the agent development lifecycle, demonstrated through hands-on work, formal education, or self-study
  • Proven ability to demo a technical product and connect it to business outcomes
  • Demonstrated ability to understand Python or SQL scripts
  • Strong communication and executive presentation skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders
  • Depth in at least one industry (financial services, healthcare, retail, tech) or function is a plus
