title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Program Manager
description:
About The Role

Senior Regulatory Affairs Program Manager is the primary regulatory strategist and architect for our AI/ML Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) portfolio. While many companies view Regulatory Affairs as a purely administrative function, at Hinge Health we leverage this role as a technical discipline.

In this role, you will be responsible for the hands-on authorship and management of regulatory submissions (510(k), De Novo, Pre-Subs) for our cutting-edge AI products. You will partner closely with Product, Clinical, and Engineering teams to interpret the evolving FDA framework for AI/ML, helping us navigate complex pathways like Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCP). You will also own the internal regulatory functions that support our Quality Management System, ensuring our rapid innovation remains compliant.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Submission Leadership (AI/ML SaMD): Lead the planning, authorship, and submission of regulatory filings (510(k), De Novo, Q-Submissions) for AI/ML-enabled software. You will be the primary author, not just a reviewer, translating complex technical and clinical data into compelling regulatory narratives.

  • Regulatory Strategy & AI Policy: Develop and execute regulatory strategies for new product introductions and major software updates. You will serve as the internal authority on the FDA’s evolving AI/ML Action Plan, guiding the business on how to validate and monitor adaptive algorithms.

  • Design Control & Change Impact: Participate in Design Reviews and Change Control Boards (CCB) to assess the regulatory impact of software changes. You will determine when a new 510(k) or "Letter to File" is required, specifically evaluating changes to AI models and retraining pipelines.

  • QMS & Internal Compliance: Support the maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS) by ensuring regulatory requirements (21 CFR 820, ISO 13485) are reflected in internal procedures. You will act as the Regulatory representative during internal and external audits (FDA, ISO).

  • Promotional Review: Review and approve labeling, marketing materials, and user manuals to ensure claims are substantiated and consistent with cleared indications for use.

  • Post-Market Surveillance & Vigilance: Partner with Quality to monitor post-market performance of AI models. You will lead the assessment of complaints for regulatory reporting requirements (e.g., eMDRs) and manage any necessary recalls or field actions.

  • Cross-Functional Coaching: Educate technical teams on regulatory principles, demystifying the submission process and helping engineers understand how their documentation directly supports regulatory clearance.

title: Firmware Engineer II
description:
About the Role

Hinge Health is seeking a Firmware Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team. In this role, you will play a key part in designing and developing our next-generation hardware products.

As a junior-to-mid-level engineer, you will work on diverse projects, driving firmware / embedded software for highly integrated medical devices. You will work cross-functionally with electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing teams to bring products from concept through production.

description:
About the Role

At Hinge Health, we’re transforming care at scale, helping millions of people live pain-free lives. Now, we're looking for a Director of Product Management to lead one of our most member-critical product areas: the Member Journey.

Member Journey defines the framework for the end-to-end experience. That includes how members enroll, receive care, and see a reduction in their pain through Hinge Health. This is the leader for a group of product pods directly tied to our core member outcomes: onboarding, long term retention, new program growth, and outcomes. Done well, it turns an employer benefit into a habit-forming care relationship.

As a Director of Product Management, you'll lead a team of PMs to define the vision for the next-generation member experience in digital healthcare, including how personalization and AI reshape what it means to deliver care at scale.

Identify friction points, develop program platforms, growing our suite of programs and program extensions, and developing habits that keep members coming back.

title: Client Executive
description:
The Opportunity

At Hinge Health, we're transforming how millions of people access musculoskeletal care—helping them move beyond pain through AI-powered, personalized healthcare. As a Client Executive, you'll be the strategic architect behind our most valuable partnerships, managing a portfolio of complex Enterprise and Jumbo clients who trust us to deliver exceptional outcomes for their members.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complexity. You'll manage strategic relationships with enterprise clients, navigating multiple stakeholder groups (e.g. client, consultant, health plan, etc), competing priorities, and high-stakes conversations. Success demands independent problem-solving—when challenges arise, you'll be expected to develop and present solutions rather than simply escalate problems. You'll work across multiple cross-functional teams (Growth, Sales, Data, Marketing, Operations, Product, Clinical) to deliver outcomes, requiring strong project management skills and the ability to influence without direct authority.

The ideal candidate is energized by building executive relationships (internally and externally) and solving complex business challenges. You should be someone who naturally gravitates toward strategic thinking, enjoys high-stakes conversations, and finds fulfillment in turning client challenges into expansion opportunities.

What You'll Accomplish

Strategic Account Retention
Drive exceptional client retention through proactive relationship management, strategic account planning, and early risk identification across your assigned portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts. Build deep, multi-threaded client relationships that create sustainable competitive advantage and position Hinge Health as an indispensable strategic partner rather than a vendor.

Executive Relationship Management
Build and maintain meaningful relationships per client across different organizational levels. Identify decision-makers, map influence networks, and establish trust with C-suite executives through strategic value conversations that demonstrate measurable business impact.

Independent Strategic Thinking
When facing client challenges, research solutions, analyze options, and present recommendations with data-driven rationale. Facilitate cross-functional problem-solving and drive decisions without constant management oversight, acting as the trusted advisor clients turn to during critical moments.

Revenue Impact Focus
Understand how each client interaction connects to business outcomes (retention, expansion, competitive positioning) and articulate the specific value you're creating through relationship investments. Consistently achieve 100%+ net revenue retention through strategic renewals and expansion opportunities.

Who You Are

  • A Strategic Relationship Builder: You don't just manage accounts—you architect partnerships. You naturally build trust with C-suite executives and can navigate complex organizational hierarchies with ease.

  • An Independent Problem Solver: When challenges arise, you don't escalate—you investigate, develop solutions, and present recommendations. You thrive in ambiguity and can facilitate cross-functional alignment without formal authority.

  • Resilient Under Pressure: You energize during renewal seasons and high-stakes negotiations. Compressed timelines and competing priorities don't overwhelm you—they motivate you.

  • Data-Driven and Strategic: You translate complex data (utilization metrics, claims analyses, stakeholder feedback) into compelling executive-level narratives that drive purchasing decisions and strategic alignment.

Basic Requirements

  • 10+ years in enterprise account management with demonstrated success managing strategic client relationships. Healthcare, benefits, or SaaS experience strongly preferred.

  • Proven track record of managing strategic enterprise accounts simultaneously while maintaining exceptional retention rates (95%+) in high-growth or competitive environments.

  • Complex stakeholder management expertise across multiple organizational levels, including C-suite executives, procurement teams, and operational stakeholders.

  • Strategic relationship building with ability to establish trust quickly, maintain engagement during extended renewal cycles (12+ months), and recover from at-risk accounts. Must provide specific examples of turning around challenging client situations.

  • Experience achieving 100%+ net revenue retention, including managing contract negotiations, performance guarantee discussions, and pricing conversations with procurement and C-suite stakeholders.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience navigating organizational changes (mergers, leadership transitions, budget cuts) while preserving client relationships and identifying expansion opportunities.

  • Experience working with intermediaries (consultants, brokers, health plans) who influence but don't control purchasing decisions.

  • Demonstrated ability to conduct competitive analyses and translate complex data (utilization data, claims analyses, stakeholder feedback) into executive-level presentations that drive purchasing decisions.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Outcomes
description:
The Opportunity

Pain reduction isn't a vanity metric at Hinge Health — it's the mission. The Outcomes pod owns the member-facing surfaces that make clinical progress visible (pain logging, health assessments, outcomes visualization) and the Assessment Service, the company-wide platform that powers every structured survey and PROM across Migraine, Perisurgical, Women's Pelvic Health, and beyond. As the Engineering Manager for this team, you'll lead 8 engineers at the intersection of consumer product craft, clinical measurement rigor, and platform engineering — turning clinical signal into product bets and operating the infrastructure the entire organization depends on.

What You'll Accomplish

In your first 3 months, you will:

  • Build trusted partnerships with your PM, Data Scientist, and cross-neighborhood engineering leads. Understand the full stack — from the React Native client (phoenix) through phoenix-bff to assessment-service — and complete your first code reviews and PR merges.

  • Audit the current Assessment Service roadmap, catalog inbound requests from partner pods (Migraine, Perisurgical, Enrollment), and establish a transparent prioritization framework that balances internal roadmap with external partner needs.

  • Immerse yourself in the team's experimentation culture: review active A/B tests on pain logging cadence and member engagement, and set expectations for rigorous go/no-go criteria going forward.

In your first 6 months, you will:

  • Ship at least one experiment that demonstrably moves a core clinical metric — pain reduction, survey engagement, or PSFS improvement — and build the analytical discipline so results are trusted org-wide.

  • Define and publish contribution patterns for the Assessment Service so partner pods can extend the platform without creating bottlenecks, reducing ad-hoc cross-team coordination overhead.

  • Deepen the pod's AI-native development practices — expanding use of autonomous agents, CI-enforced harness engineering patterns, and developer tooling that increases engineering throughput.

In your first year, you will:

  • Own the outcomes product surface end-to-end: pain logging UX, progress tracking, outcomes visualization, and health assessment experiences that members love and clinicians trust.

  • Ensure Outcomes data is a durable company asset — well-modeled, well-documented, and wired into the clinical and commercial reporting stack — not just a sprint metric.

  • Grow and develop a high-performing team, raising the engineering bar through hiring, mentorship, and career-ladder progression while sustaining a culture that values both clinical impact and platform reliability.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

Who You Are

  • A builder who stays close to the code. You're a hands-on engineering leader (~15% IC time) who reviews PRs, contributes architecture input, and earns trust through technical credibility — not just org-chart authority. You embody Hinge Health's Lead at All Levels principle.

  • A systems thinker with product instincts. You can reason across service architecture, data modeling, and client-side UX tradeoffs — and you know when a platform decision will ripple across a dozen downstream consumers.

  • An experiment-minded operator. You don't just ship features; you design bets, define success criteria, and hold the team accountable to outcomes. You exemplify Hustle — measuring yourself by results and impact, not actions or good intentions.

  • A cross-functional partner. You communicate clearly across engineering, clinical, data science, and product teams to align on shared goals — demonstrating Effective Communication and Accountability.

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

  • 3+ years of experience managing a team of 5+ engineers in a product or platform engineering environment

  • Experience owning a shared platform or service consumed by multiple internal teams — with the judgment to balance internal roadmap with external partner needs

  • Track record of running experiments and reasoning about outcomes metrics — not just shipping features

  • React Native / Mobile: Working knowledge of React Native or equivalent mobile development experience

title: Senior Staff Data Engineer - Data & ML Platform
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Staff Data Engineer to be the technical backbone of our Data & ML Platform team — the foundation powering analytics, product experiences, and machine learning across Hinge Health. This is a high-ownership IC role for someone who wants to set the technical vision for the platform, drive architecture across organizational boundaries, and shape how Hinge Health builds on data and ML for years to come.

Your scope extends beyond any single team or system. You'll own the most consequential architectural decisions across the data platform — how streaming and batch systems converge, how data models serve both analytical and ML workloads, and how the platform evolves as the company's AI ambitions scale. You'll work in a modern stack including Python, SQL, Spark, dbt, Kafka, Flink, Databricks, and AWS, and increasingly at the boundary where data platform meets ML platform — feature pipelines, serving layers, and the infrastructure that makes ML models production-ready.

This is not a role where you go deep on a single system. You'll operate across the full platform surface — identifying the highest-leverage technical problems the organization faces, driving alignment across engineering, Data Science, and product teams, and making architectural decisions that others build on. You should be equally comfortable authoring a platform-wide technical strategy, debugging a production incident, mentoring senior engineers, and explaining tradeoffs to leadership.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Set the technical vision for the data platform: Own the long-term architectural direction for how streaming and batch systems, data models, and serving layers fit together. Make the architectural decisions that other teams and engineers build on — balancing reliability, performance, cost, and long-term maintainability across the platform.

  • Build at the intersection of data and ML platform: Design the infrastructure that connects the data platform to ML workloads — feature pipelines, feature stores, and serving layers. Partner with Data Science to ensure the data platform produces ML-ready data and supports model training and inference workflows reliably.

  • Raise the engineering bar across the organization: Set standards that extend beyond your immediate team — data modeling patterns, schema governance, testing practices, pipeline reliability, and code quality. Mentor senior engineers, influence engineering culture, and be the technical authority the broader R&D organization looks to on data platform decisions.

  • Drive cross-organizational technical initiatives: Lead complex initiatives that span multiple teams, services, and domains. Define data contracts with upstream services, drive schema evolution strategies, and resolve systemic technical friction between data producers and consumers across the company.

  • Own platform reliability and operational excellence: Drive the reliability posture of the most critical data systems. Lead improvements in observability, data quality, incident response, and cost efficiency at a platform level — making the data foundation trustworthy enough that every team in the organization can build confidently on top of it.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

Basic Qualifications

  • A minimum of 4+ years of hands-on data engineering experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Experience architecting data systems across batch and streaming paradigms, including technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark, or equivalent.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with deep experience in distributed data processing frameworks and data platform design.

You understand the ML lifecycle well enough to design data systems that serve it effectively.

  • Track record of setting technical direction across an organization — driving alignment across multiple teams, making architectural decisions with broad impact, and delivering outcomes without formal authority.

  • Demonstrated experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture and standards beyond your immediate team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Data Engineering: 10+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, with a significant portion spent in platform or infrastructure roles building systems that other teams depend on.

  • Deep data modeling and governance instincts: You care about schema design, data contracts, and data quality as much as you care about pipeline throughput. You've driven improvements in how upstream services produce data and how downstream teams consume it.

  • Product and business awareness: You connect your technical work to the problems the business is trying to solve. You understand the product use cases your platform enables and use that context to prioritize and make better architectural choices.

  • Operational rigor in regulated environments: You value SLOs, incident management, and observability as first-class concerns. Experience in HIPAA, SOC 2, or similarly regulated environments is a plus.

title: Staff Software Engineer, CV UX
description:
The Opportunity

Over 1.7 billion people worldwide live with musculoskeletal pain — and Hinge Health is on a mission to help them move beyond it. Our TrueMotion computer vision technology turns everyday mobile devices into powerful motion-tracking tools, giving members real-time feedback and guidance as they work through personalized exercise therapy. The CV User Experience team is responsible for making that magic feel effortless: building deeply interactive, TrueMotion-driven features that monitor movement, coach performance, and track recovery progress.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to serve as the technical leader for this team — someone who can architect end-to-end systems across mobile and backend, tackle complex scaling challenges, and raise the bar on engineering quality. If you're passionate about building high-quality software that directly improves people's health outcomes, this is your role.

What You'll Accomplish

In your first 3 months:

  • Ramp into the CV User Experience stack (React Native, TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, AWS) and build relationships with product managers, designers, data scientists, and computer vision scientists.

  • Deliver your first end-to-end feature while auditing the current architecture for scaling and performance bottlenecks.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

In your first 6 months:

title: Quality Assurance Associate Manager, Growth Marketing Operations
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a QA Associate Manager to join our Growth Marketing Operations (GROMO) team. This role is ideal for someone with a strong background in marketing campaign testing and quality assurance, with expertise in audience segmentation, personalization logic, and campaign execution validation.

This role requires a deep working knowledge of marketing deployment platforms—including how to build, test, and troubleshoot campaigns using systems like Iterable, Adobe Journey Optimizer, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working within these platforms to design campaign logic, validate audience segmentation, resolve execution failures, and monitor post-send performance. You understand not just how to test campaigns, but how the underlying system logic impacts deliverability, targeting accuracy, and cross-channel orchestration.

The primary focus will be on testing, diagnosing, and optimizing marketing campaigns across multiple channels, including email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging. You will work closely with marketing, CRM, and data teams to ensure flawless campaign execution and identify potential issues before launch.

As Hinge Health continues to scale its marketing complexity, this role will also help evolve QA toward more automated, AI-assisted, human-supervised ways of working. At the P3 level, that means using AI and automation to improve the speed, consistency, and depth of campaign validation, while applying strong judgment to verify outputs, investigate anomalies, and recommend practical process improvements. This role is not expected to set the company-wide AI QA strategy, but it should actively contribute to a more modern, scalable quality practice through thoughtful experimentation and day-to-day adoption of new tools.

description:
The Role

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to join our Referrals team and help us build a unified Incentive Platform. The domain that tracks eligibility, entitlement, and fulfillment state for incentive rewards. Our team owns and operates this platform: the system of record for what a member is owed and when.

This is a high-ownership, systems-first role within the team. You'll set technical direction for a platform that's mid-consolidation. You'll work closely with product and data science, and have a direct line to business outcomes like referral conversion and cost-per-acquisition.

We’re now building a team from the ground up to launch our Gastrointestinal (GI) Care Program. GI conditions affect roughly one in four U.S. adults and drive $135 billion in annual medical spending, yet access to specialized care remains limited.

Our planned acquisition of Cylinder Health, a leader in virtual-first digestive healthcare, gives us a strong foundation for entering this market. Together, the teams will combine Cylinder’s clinical expertise and market presence with Hinge Health’s AI-powered care model and technology platform.

This is an opportunity for an engineering leader to build a new product from the ground up, shape the future of digital GI care, and define the experience millions of Americans could access through their healthcare plans in 2027.

As the Engineering Manager for GI, you’ll build an understanding for the 60M+ Americans afflicted by this health condition, ensuring that Hinge Health builds a comprehensive end-to-end experience to treat them, run rapid experiments to validate your assumptions, and launch a brand new digital care product for GI. What differentiates HingeHealth from other platforms is our fast pace of innovation blending licensed care providers with AI solutions and medical grade hardware to deliver a complete experience that improves the health of our users.

You’ll partner closely with senior leadership, Product, Design, and Marketing across our hubs in San Francisco, Montreal, and Bangalore to build a new GI product. As a hands-on engineering leader, you’ll stay close to the stack, regularly contributing to and reviewing code (~15% of your time) while building a high-performing team around you.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months, you will:

  • Build a team of 5 engineers building across our React Native (Phoenix) mobile codebase and backend services (Go & JS), establishing clear goals, rituals, and expectations for a high-performing team.

  • Define the new vertical/product line from scratch.

  • Build strong partnerships with Product, Design, and Marketing to align on the strategy, experimentation roadmap, and success metrics.

In your first 6 months, you will:

  • Build the “new vertical” product as a minimum loveable product (MLP) defining how to use display software, AI solutions and licensed care providers to deliver a significant health improvement for members.

  • Establish a rigorous portfolio of A/B experiments to run post launch of the new product planning for funnel optimizations to ensure success of members.

  • Establish engineering best practices for CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and client performance across the entire stack.

Within 12 months and beyond, you will:

  • Have launched the “new vertical” product.

  • Execute a series of A/B experiments to increase usage and success of the new product

  • Grow and mentor your team, raising the bar on engineering quality, experimentation rigor, and operational excellence.

Who You Are

  • 0->1 Builder: We are looking for engineering managers with a track record of building new products from scratch.

  • Talent magnet: someone who can quickly pull together a team to build the “new vertical” product.

  • You move fast, know how to balance innovation vs reuse, and deliver clear business results..

  • Hands-on engineering leader: You’re comfortable reading and writing code in modern stacks (e.g., React Native, BFF/full-stack web, GraphQL), and you use that fluency to coach, review, and set technical direction.

  • Experiment-driven operator: You think in terms of hypotheses, sample sizes, and decision rules, and you can run a dense A/B experimentation roadmap without sacrificing quality.

  • Systems and UX thinker: You see how architecture, API design, and client performance shape real-world member experiences—and you can align cross-functional partners around trade-offs.

  • Inclusive team builder: You create clear expectations, give direct feedback, and foster a culture where engineers can do the best work of their careers.

Basic Qualifications

  • A minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • A minimum of 3+ years of experience managing a team of ~5+ engineers in a fast-paced, product-focused environment.

  • AI-native development: Expertise using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or similar AI agents as development resources to drastically improve the pace of experimentation, with opinions on prompting, agent review, and harness engineering.

  • Strong React Native, mobile, or client-side engineering background — or equivalent depth in a BFF/full-stack web context with a track record of shipping member-facing UI at scale.

  • Experience owning and evolving a major product surface end-to-end — from architecture and UX through experimentation and production reliability.

  • Demonstrated ability to design, run, and interpret A/B experiments, including comfort reasoning about sample sizes, interference effects, and decision rules.

Preferred Qualifications

  • React Native: Experience building or leading teams in large React Native codebases, including client performance, render optimization, and app architecture patterns.

  • Server-Driven UI: Familiarity with SDUI patterns and the trade-offs of moving layout and presentation logic from client to server.

  • Platform mindset: History operating a shared product surface that other teams extend—defining extension contracts, managing inbound requests, and protecting stability.

  • GraphQL & modern stacks: Familiarity with GraphQL (caching, BFF patterns, client-driven data-fetching performance), plus working knowledge of Python, TypeScript/Node.js, AWS services (e.g., Lambda, SQS, SNS, SageMaker), and modern DevOps practices.

  • Regulated environments: Experience working within healthcare (HIPAA) or other highly regulated domains involving sensitive member data.

description:

title: Staff Engineer, MSK Verticals
description:
About the Role

Join the team responsible for the products at the heart of how Hinge Health delivers care for musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions. This team owns our core MSK programs and the build-out of new ones, like our recently launched migraine offering, that let us scale the business into new conditions and reach more members.

As a Staff Engineer, you'll help take new programs of care from early concept to a stable, scaled offering, then keep sharpening what already works. That means building the greenfield features that make a new program a real, differentiated offering, not just an existing treatment experience with a new label. It also means extending and hardening the shared services that power all of our programs. You'll work closely with Product and with engineers across multiple partner teams to ship a coherent, end-to-end program of care for our members.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Lead through influence: Take on the team's most ambiguous or technically complex problems, setting direction through your own technical work, design docs, and mentorship rather than through formal authority. Sometimes that means digging into the platform itself, when that's what's holding the team back from scaling into new programs of care.

  • Bring new programs of care to life: Lead the technical design and delivery of new MSK programs (in the vein of our migraine launch), building the features and workflows that make each program a credible, differentiated offering.

description:

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Care Interactions team, you will shape and build the systems that enable Hinge Health’s care teams to communicate with members and deliver personalized musculoskeletal care at scale. Care Interactions is part of CareHub, Hinge Health’s internal care-delivery platform used by physical therapists, health coaches, physicians, care managers, and other clinical teams.

The team owns core communication and care-delivery capabilities, including in-app messaging, video visits, scheduling-related experiences, clinical notes, care plans, and the CareHub interaction record used for coordinated care. You will provide technical leadership across these complex, workflow-heavy domains, helping the team build reliable, secure, and intuitive products that reduce fragmented tools and repetitive administrative work so care team members can focus on clinical judgment and member connection.

CareHub is evolving toward an AI-first platform. In this role, you may help build AI-assisted capabilities for visit preparation, documentation, summarization, contextual recommendations, and follow-up workflows. You will contribute to systems that are clinically useful, observable, resilient, and safe, with appropriate human oversight for decisions that affect care delivery.

You will partner closely with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and other engineering teams to take problems from discovery through production. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact, workflow-heavy products where thoughtful technical decisions can improve care-team efficiency, member experience, and Hinge Health’s ability to deliver care at scale.

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will write production code, lead architecture and design reviews, participate in operational response, and coach engineers toward stronger technical ownership.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents.

  • Collaborate with your team to roadmap and execute ambitious technical strategies, balancing short-term and long-term trade-offs.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing.

  • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features, contributing to Hinge Health’s AI-driven care platform.

  • Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team’s features, and contribute to the team’s overall architecture and developer tooling.

  • Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.

  • Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).

  • Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT).

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field

  • 10+ years of non-internship full time professional software development experience

  • 4+ years of experience with at least one software programming language

  • 4+ years of experience in the full software development life cycle

  • 3+ years of work experience with react JS and Node JS/ Typescript

  • 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making

  • Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, LangChain, LangGraph

  • Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment.

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications

  • A platform-as-product mindset: understanding internal users and consumers, defining clear contracts, improving developer experience and adoption, and measuring platform outcomes.

  • Strong backend and distributed-systems fundamentals, including latency, throughput, availability, capacity, backpressure, consistency, resilience, and failure-mode analysis.

  • Experience integrating large language models or generative AI services into production workflows with appropriate evals, validation, observability, and failure handling.

  • Experience defining and maintaining SLOs and SLAs, using error budgets, service-health metrics, alerting, on-call practices, incident response, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability.

  • Experience improving observability through metrics, structured logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with practical knowledge of cache design and invalidation, database performance KPIs, query and index tuning, connection pools, and capacity management

  • Experience with headless CMS integrations, webhook-driven systems, vendor adapters, content delivery networks, or publishing pipelines.

  • Experience with durable workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal, or comparable workflow technology.

  • Experience with media processing tools such as ffmpeg, adaptive bitrate video, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, or caption formats such as WebVTT.

  • Experience with event streaming, such as Kafka, and CI/CD automation, such as GitHub Actions.

  • Experience working in healthcare, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or otherwise high-trust environments.

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or serving as a technical lead for a platform, migration, or cross-functional launch.

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

What You'll Love About Us

description:

You’ll own and improve the systems behind our corporate technology environment—from endpoint management, networking, and identity to cloud platforms and internal AI-enabled workflows. The Financial Systems team builds and operates the billing and financial infrastructure that powers how Hinge Health makes money. Our systems support the movement of revenue-critical data across products, payers, and internal financial workflows. As Hinge Health expands into new products such as HingeSelect, introduces more complex payment models, adds multi-payer integrations, and grows globally, we need engineers who can build systems that are correct, observable, secure, and resilient at scale.

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer who is excited to work on high-impact financial systems where correctness and reliability matter. You will help design the technical foundations for billing and financial workflows, improve the traceability of money-related data, and make it easier for our product, operations, and Finance partners to deliver a seamless experience for members and customers.

The ideal candidate thrives in cross-functional collaboration, is comfortable with ambiguity, and takes a systems-thinking approach to problems involving data integrity, integrations, operational workflows, and long-term maintainability. You care about the details, understand the customer impact of financial systems, and take ownership from design through production operation.

Backend engineers at Hinge Health contribute to their team’s success by architecting and implementing end-to-end solutions, well-tested and performant APIs, and durable data models. You will profile systems to stay ahead of scaling bottlenecks, participate in thoughtful and constructive code reviews, and help maintain a high engineering bar.

We practice continuous deployment and expect owner-operators to support the systems they build in production. Our production systems rely on Golang, gRPC, AWS, Postgres, Redis, and Temporal. Our workflow is trunk-based CI/CD, and our security and compliance posture reflects the standards required for healthcare, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and CCPA.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects across billing and financial workflows, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Design and evolve reliable services, APIs, and data models for revenue-critical systems, including billing flows, payment-model changes, payer integrations, and financial data movement.

  • Build for correctness and traceability by establishing clear data ownership, durable workflows, idempotent processing, strong validation, and actionable audit and operational signals.

  • Break down complex, cross-functional problems into manageable tasks, enabling steady delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents and data discrepancies.

  • Collaborate with Product, Finance, Operations, Data, and partner engineering teams to define requirements, roadmap technical strategy, and balance short-term delivery with long-term system health.

  • Improve the maintainability, availability, performance, and observability of financial systems, including developer tooling and operational runbooks.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers through thoughtful code reviews, pairing, design feedback, and knowledge sharing.

  • Communicate technical ideas clearly to technical and non-technical partners, and document decisions and workflows so they remain understandable as the team grows.

  • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate engineering and operational processes and enhance product capabilities, while preserving appropriate review and control for financial workflows.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 3+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software development experience.

  • 2+ years of experience with at least one programming language.

  • 2+ years of experience across the full software development life cycle, from design through production support.

  • Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment.

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Golang, Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Experience designing and operating backend services, APIs, data models, and asynchronous or distributed workflows.

  • Experience working with relational databases and integrations where data integrity, failure handling, and observability are important.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners and communicate technical trade-offs clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building billing, payments, revenue, accounting, claims, or other financial systems.

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and scalable cloud services.

  • Experience with Golang, Python, gRPC, Postgres, Redis, Temporal, AWS\

  • Experience improving data quality, operational visibility, incident response, or developer tooling for critical systems.

  • Experience mentoring or onboarding junior engineers.

  • Experience with AI technologies for software design, coding assistance, or process automation.

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office has a dog-friendly workplace program.

title: Support Knowledge Manager
description:
About the role

Join the team transforming how we support Hinge Health members by building the knowledge engine that powers both human specialists and AI.

As the Support Knowledge Manager, you will own the structure, quality, and day-to-day health of support knowledge. You will strengthen and scale our content operations program, create practical standards for how knowledge is written and maintained, and help teams keep information current as our products, services, and processes evolve. Your work will ensure our member-facing teams and the systems supporting them always retrieve the right information at the right time.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building new systems and repeatable processes. You will own and shape Support’s knowledge management program end to end, with the opportunity to establish the structure, standards, and cross-department partnerships that improve how our teams support members at scale.

Who You Are

  • You are an information architect who enjoys designing clear structures, ownership models, and content lifecycles.

  • You are a strong writer and editor who can turn complex information into clear, practical guidance.

  • You are an operator who can lead at all levels, make progress in ambiguity, and build workflows and processes that others can adopt.

  • You are a collaborative partner who can influence across teams and build trust without relying on formal authority.

  • You are curious, pragmatic, and motivated by improving the experience for members and the teams who support them.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Build a clear picture of our current support knowledge, including internal articles, help center content, macros and scripting, process and policy documentation, and product guides.

  • Define core content health measures and stand up a basic dashboard to create visibility into content coverage, consistency, freshness, utilization, and performance.

  • Define practical content standards and a review process, including clear owners, approval paths, and update and review timelines.

  • Improve the information architecture of our knowledge base, including taxonomy, labeling, metadata, templates, and content relationships.

  • Rewrite content so it is clear and useful for frontline specialists, AI systems, and other content consumers at Hinge Health.

  • Establish working relationships and feedback loops within Support Operations and with Quality, Product, Marketing/Brand, and other content owners and consumers across the company.

In your first 6 months

  • Operationalize a regular reporting cadence and use the measures to prioritize improvements, tracking indicators such as verification status, content age, time to publish, content utilization, and search coverage.

  • Create feedback loops with Support Operations (Service Delivery and Support Systems), Analytics, and Quality teams to identify improvement opportunities and turn recurring questions into prioritized content improvements.

  • Launch repeatable processes with partner teams for documenting launches, product changes, policy updates, and operational changes.

In your first year

  • Own and continuously improve the support knowledge program, including its structure, standards, ownership model, review cadence, and performance reporting.

  • Optimize how content tools and AI-supported workflows work together, partnering with vendors, Product, and Engineering to understand performance and prioritize improvements that improve member support outcomes.

  • Improve the reliability of the information used by both specialists and AI, contributing to improvements in AI-supported resolutions, specialist productivity, ticket handle time, and CSAT.

  • Support content localization and scalable practices as Hinge Health expands into new markets.

  • Become a trusted partner to Support and cross-functional teams that create or maintain member-facing or internal-facing knowledge.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience owning or managing knowledge, content, documentation, ideally for a support operations, customer service, or similar customer-facing department. Comfortable using content health and support data to prioritize work and measure success.

  • Experience managing content for multiple audiences and formats, such as internal support guidance, help center articles, process or policy documentation, and internal- and external-facing product guides.

  • Hands-on experience administering a knowledge base or content repository. Experience with tools such as Zendesk Guide, Salesforce Knowledge, Intercom, Confluence, Guru, or a comparable platform is valuable.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (for example: Communications, Technical Writing, Information Science, Business) or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using AI tools to improve content workflows, such as drafting, localizing, updating, or reviewing content, with a willingness to continue learning as the tools evolve.

  • Experience supporting a technical SaaS, consumer technology, or other complex product.

  • Familiarity with customer support AI tools, virtual agents, search, AI-assisted knowledge workflows.

  • Familiarity with Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) or a similar knowledge-management methodology.

  • Experience partnering with Quality Assurance, Product, Engineering, and vendors to optimize content for AI retrieval.

title: Registered Dietitian (Flex)
description:
About the Role

Join Hinge Health's GI Care team and help members improve their digestive health through personalized, evidence-based nutrition care.

As a Registered Dietitian, you'll provide Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) and behavior-change coaching to members managing a wide range of digestive health conditions. Through virtual visits and in-app messaging, you'll build meaningful relationships with members, help them navigate complex symptoms, and empower them to make sustainable changes that improve their health and quality of life.

You'll be part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary care team that values clinical expertise, professional judgment, and whole-person care. Hinge Health combines innovative technology with human-centered care, giving you the tools and support to focus on what matters most: helping members achieve meaningful health outcomes.

A Flexible Approach to Care Delivery

This is a remote, W-2 position with a flexible scheduling model designed to align clinician capacity with member demand.

  • Guaranteed minimum of 25 paid hours per week, with the opportunity to work up to 40 hours based on business needs.

  • Advance scheduling visibility: Receive an outlook of your anticipated hours approximately one month in advance, with your schedule confirmed at least two weeks ahead.

  • Paid time for more than just appointments: Your scheduled hours include member visits, documentation, care coordination, team meetings, and other clinical responsibilities.

  • No need to build your own caseload: Hinge Health connects members with their care team and facilitates appointment scheduling.

  • Consistent compensation during scheduled hours: Cancellations and no-shows do not reduce your pay for scheduled working time.

We're looking for clinicians who enjoy working in an evolving digital health environment, are comfortable with variable weekly schedules, and are excited to help shape the future of virtual nutrition care.

What you'll do

  • Deliver individualized Medical Nutrition Therapy: Assess and support members managing conditions such as IBS, IBD, GERD, chronic constipation and diarrhea, gastroparesis, SIBO, food intolerances, malnutrition, and other digestive health concerns.

  • Build meaningful member relationships: Provide compassionate, personalized care that helps members feel heard, supported, and empowered to manage their digestive health.

  • Support sustainable behavior change: Partner with members to establish realistic goals, develop practical strategies, and build habits that support long-term health.

  • Use clinical judgment to guide care: Individualize nutrition interventions, appointment frequency, and ongoing support based on each member's needs, goals, and progress.

  • Provide continuous support: Combine virtual visits with personalized in-app messaging to reinforce progress, answer questions, and maintain engagement between appointments.

  • Collaborate with an interdisciplinary team: Work closely with health coaches and other clinicians to deliver coordinated, whole-person care.

  • Leverage innovative technology: Use digital health tools, clinical resources, and AI-supported workflows to enhance care delivery while maintaining clinical judgment and a human-centered approach.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement: Share clinical insights, member feedback, and opportunities to improve the care experience and delivery model.

  • Maintain high-quality clinical documentation: Complete timely, accurate documentation and follow established clinical standards, protocols, and escalation processes.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for Registered Dietitians who are passionate about digestive health, skilled at building relationships, and excited about delivering high-quality care in a virtual environment.

  • Member-Centered Care. You lead with empathy, listen actively, and understand that every member's experience with digestive health is unique. You can translate complex nutrition recommendations into practical, achievable steps.

  • Strong Clinical Judgment. You apply evidence-based nutrition principles, think critically, and individualize care based on member needs rather than relying on a one-size-fits-all approach.

  • Effective Coaching and Communication. You know how to build rapport, support behavior change, and help members make meaningful progress. You're comfortable communicating through both video visits and written messaging.

  • Collaboration and Teamwork. You value learning from others, sharing knowledge, and working collaboratively to deliver the best possible member experience.

  • Adaptability and Growth Mindset. You're curious, open to feedback, and comfortable learning new approaches as digital healthcare continues to evolve.

  • Technology-Enabled Care. You're confident using technology to support clinical care and comfortable working with AI-powered tools while applying your professional judgment to ensure accuracy, safety, and personalization.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in nutrition, dietetics, or a related field

  • Active Registered Dietitian credential through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR)

  • Active, unrestricted state licensure as required for clinical practice

  • At least 1 year of relevant clinical experience

  • Experience providing nutrition counseling, behavior-change coaching, or chronic disease management

  • Strong interpersonal, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfort managing a clinical caseload and delivering care in a fast-paced environment

  • Proficiency with digital tools and the ability to learn new technology

  • Ability to independently deliver telehealth services from a private, professional workspace with reliable internet access within the United States

  • Availability to work variable schedules of 25–40 hours per week, including some evening hours, within designated operating hours of 7 a.m.–10 p.m. Central Time

  • Willingness to appear as a member of the clinical care team within the Hinge Health product and related materials

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in nutrition, dietetics, or a related field

  • Experience providing Medical Nutrition Therapy for digestive health conditions

  • Experience working in telehealth or digital health

  • Active licensure in multiple states

  • Bilingual proficiency in Spanish and English, with the ability to complete a language competency assessment

  • Additional training or certifications in gastrointestinal nutrition, behavior change, or related specialties

  • Availability to work occasional weekend hours

title: Senior AI Engineer, MLOps & Distributed Systems
description:
The Opportunity

Join the team building the intelligence behind Hinge Health’s proactive member experience. The Proactive Communications & Notifications pod is creating the systems that determine what message a member receives, when they receive it, and which channel is most helpful. When these decisions are timely, relevant, and respectful, they can help members stay engaged with care and make progress toward better health outcomes.

As a Senior AI Engineer focused on MLOps and distributed systems, you will own the production path that turns models and AI capabilities into dependable member-facing experiences. You’ll design and operate the deployment, serving, release automation, monitoring, rollback, orchestration, and backend integration systems that make AI reliable, observable, scalable, and cost-conscious in production.

You’ll work closely with ML Scientists, Data Scientists, Data Engineering, Product, and Software Engineering. This role is a strong fit for an MLOps-oriented software engineer who brings deep backend and distributed-systems judgment. You do not need to be a research scientist or own model training strategy; your impact will come from making AI capabilities safe to ship, easy to operate, and straightforward for the team to improve.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 3 months

  • Build context on Hinge Health’s member experience, communication systems, model lifecycle, data flows, and operational requirements.

  • Establish a clear baseline for the health of key AI-backed services, including service-level objectives, deployment paths, observability, failure modes, and operational ownership.

  • Ship targeted improvements to developer experience, testing, release safety, or incident response that make the team faster and more predictable.

In your first 6 months

  • Own the design and delivery of a production MLOps or distributed-systems initiative from technical plan through rollout, measurement, and iteration.

  • Build or improve safe promotion patterns for model-backed services, including versioning, configuration, feature flags, canaries, rollback, and recovery.

  • Partner with ML Scientists and Data Engineering to define durable interfaces, data contracts, feature inputs, freshness expectations, evaluation hooks, and production-readiness criteria.

In your first year

  • Operate reliable online and batch inference capabilities that meet clear contracts for latency, availability, correctness, resiliency, observability, and cost.

  • Create reusable patterns for APIs, services, queues, durable workflows, monitoring, and incident response that help the pod integrate AI into notifications, personalization, send-time optimization, and related experiences.

  • Lead through influence by shaping technical decisions, mentoring engineers, raising the quality bar through design and code review, and connecting system reliability to outcomes such as message relevance, engagement, reduced communication fatigue, and sustained participation in care.

Who You Are

  • You are a senior software engineer with strong backend and distributed-systems experience, and you enjoy owning systems across their full lifecycle—from architecture and implementation through launch and operations.

  • You are an owner-operator who is comfortable with on-call, incident response, debugging, root-cause analysis, and the follow-through required to prevent recurring failures.

  • You are a learn-it-all who can develop enough fluency in ML systems to ask strong questions, clarify interfaces, evaluate trade-offs, and help model owners bring their work safely into production.

  • You practice effective communication: you write clear technical proposals, make risks and decisions visible, and explain complex system behavior to technical and non-technical partners.

  • You lead at all levels by staying hands-on while creating leverage through reusable patterns, thoughtful code reviews, pairing, mentoring, and practical improvements to the team’s engineering workflow.

  • You care deeply about privacy, security, auditability, and the safe handling of sensitive healthcare data.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software engineering experience.

  • 3+ years designing, building, and operating backend or distributed systems in production, including experience participating in on-call and incident response.

  • Demonstrated experience deploying and operating ML- or AI-backed services in production, with strong proficiency in Python and at least one production backend language such as TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, or Kotlin.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or operating MLOps or ML platform capabilities, such as inference pipelines, model registries, deployment automation, monitoring, evaluation integration, or automated retraining.

  • Experience with online inference, batch scoring, recommendation systems, ranking, propensity models, or send-time optimization.

  • Experience with AWS and production technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Airflow, Databricks, MLflow, or equivalent systems.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration and long-running state, including Temporal, Step Functions, Cadence, or a comparable system.

  • Experience building observability for ML systems, including data quality, feature freshness, model behavior, prediction quality, latency, errors, and cost.

  • Experience partnering with ML Scientists or Data Scientists to define production interfaces and operate models without owning model research or training.

title: Spanish Speaking Pelvic Physical Therapist, Flex
description:
About the Role

Physical therapists are the backbone of the comprehensive clinical care team at Hinge Health. Hinge Health Physical Therapists utilize their clinical expertise and knowledge of pain science to deliver care for a large number of patients across the MSK spectrum, including pelvic health, via telehealth video visits and in-app messaging. We believe in providing the best patient-centered care by applying the Biopsychosocial model, evidence-informed practice, and innovative thinking with technology to help patients reduce pain and achieve meaningful outcomes. Through our technology-first platform, Hinge Health physical therapists improve the lives of many at scale. You will work with a diverse set of members within a team of high performing, inclusive clinicians.


Our physical therapists are on the bleeding edge of delivering virtual MSK care enabled by advanced technology. Come join us if you’re excited to evolve alongside the future of PT practice!

The role is called “Flex Physical Therapist” for a reason - your flexibility and resilience is critical!

  • You thrive in situations requiring you to constantly adapt and evolve. Change is not a scary word to you, and you want to continually improve yourself, your profession, and healthcare as a whole.

  • Our Flex hour model: An essential requirement of this role is maintaining availability to work between 25 and 40 hours per week, with scheduled hours determined based on business needs. You will be notified of your schedule outlook at least one month in advance and fully confirmed 2 weeks in advance. This is not a full time, part time, or PRN position - it is a Flex position where employees must be able to commit to a variable schedule.

  • You embrace technology-forward care delivery, utilizing telehealth, in-app messaging, and a variety of digital tools to serve members at significant scale.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Evaluate and treat patients remotely utilizing a variety of digital tools to manage care and oversee technology outputs.

  • Communicate effectively to drive member engagement and articulate clinical reasoning to drive product development.

  • Knowledgeable about biopsychosocial model, patient-centered MSK care, behavior change models, pain neuroscience education, and evidence-informed practice.

  • Provides high caliber of service resulting in high customer satisfaction and improved clinical outcomes.

  • Manages patients safely and efficiently given a large and varied caseload.

Basic Qualifications

  • You have 2-4 years of clinical physical therapy experience practicing in an orthopedics setting, evaluating and treating a variety of MSK conditions.

  • At least 1 year of in person or telehealth Pelvic Health clinical experience and completion of:

    Herman & Wallace Level 1 and/or Level 2b

    APTA CAPP-Pelvic Level 1 and/or Level 2 Pelvic Health training

    Evidence In Motion Pelvic Health I and/or II

    Herman & Wallace PRPC

    ABPTS Pelvic & Women’s Health Clinical Specialist

    Evidence in Motion Pelvic Health Specialist Certification

  • or equivalent pelvic health continuing education/certification that includes content focused on: pelvic anatomy and function, bladder and bowel dysfunction, pelvic pain, prolapse, sexual and vulvovaginal conditions, internal/external examination, clinical reasoning and referral, evidence-based exercise, manual therapy, biofeedback, relaxation, and behavioral interventions.Medical fluency in Spanish (written and verbal, to be validated during the interview process)

  • Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program with a Doctorate of Physical Therapy (DPT).

  • Licensed to practice Physical Therapy in at least 1 state of the United States. Ability to complete required documentation to secure additional state licenses upon receipt of offer, within a timely manner.

  • Willing to work across time zones to serve a geographically diverse member population.

  • Serve as a visible member of our care team, which requires your name and photograph/likeness to appear in our product and associated marketing materials.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
description:
About the Role

Hinge Health is a digital health company focused on delivering evidence-based solutions for musculoskeletal (MSK) pain. By combining personalized exercise therapy with virtual care, Hinge Health helps people manage and reduce chronic pain while improving quality of life and reducing healthcare costs.

The Financial Systems team builds and operates the billing and financial infrastructure that powers how Hinge Health makes money. Our systems support the movement of revenue-critical data across products, payers, and internal financial workflows. As Hinge Health expands into new products such as HingeSelect, introduces more complex payment models, adds multi-payer integrations, and grows globally, we need engineers who can build systems that are correct, observable, secure, and resilient at scale.

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer who is excited to work on high-impact financial systems where correctness and reliability matter. You will help design the technical foundations for billing and financial workflows, improve the traceability of money-related data, and make it easier for our product, operations, and Finance partners to deliver a seamless experience for members and customers.

The ideal candidate thrives in cross-functional collaboration, is comfortable with ambiguity, and takes a systems-thinking approach to problems involving data integrity, integrations, operational workflows, and long-term maintainability. You care about the details, understand the customer impact of financial systems, and take ownership from design through production operation.

Backend engineers at Hinge Health contribute to their team’s success by architecting and implementing end-to-end solutions, well-tested and performant APIs, and durable data models. You will profile systems to stay ahead of scaling bottlenecks, participate in thoughtful and constructive code reviews, and help maintain a high engineering bar.

We practice continuous deployment and expect owner-operators to support the systems they build in production. Our production systems rely on Golang, gRPC, AWS, Postgres, Redis, and Temporal. Our workflow is trunk-based CI/CD, and our security and compliance posture reflects the standards required for healthcare, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and CCPA.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Deliver large projects across billing and financial workflows, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.

  • Design and evolve reliable services, APIs, and data models for revenue-critical systems, including billing flows, payment-model changes, payer integrations, and financial data movement.

  • Build for correctness and traceability by establishing clear data ownership, durable workflows, idempotent processing, strong validation, and actionable audit and operational signals.

  • Break down complex, cross-functional problems into manageable tasks, enabling steady delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents and data discrepancies.

  • Collaborate with Product, Finance, Operations, Data, and partner engineering teams to define requirements, roadmap technical strategy, and balance short-term delivery with long-term system health.

  • Improve the maintainability, availability, performance, and observability of financial systems, including developer tooling and operational runbooks.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers through thoughtful code reviews, pairing, design feedback, and knowledge sharing.

  • Communicate technical ideas clearly to technical and non-technical partners, and document decisions and workflows so they remain understandable as the team grows.

  • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate engineering and operational processes and enhance product capabilities, while preserving appropriate review and control for financial workflows.

  • Participate in the team’s weekly on-call rotation, helping ensure the reliability and timely support of the systems we build.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 3+ years of non-internship, full-time professional software development experience.

  • 2+ years of experience with at least one programming language.

  • 2+ years of experience across the full software development life cycle, from design through production support.

  • Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment.

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Golang, Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • Experience designing and operating backend services, APIs, data models, and asynchronous or distributed workflows.

  • Experience working with relational databases and integrations where data integrity, failure handling, and observability are important.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional partners and communicate technical trade-offs clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building billing, payments, revenue, accounting, claims, or other financial systems.

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration, and scalable cloud services.

As a hands-on technical leader, you will help define the architecture and technical direction for Member Records while continuing to build production software. You will work across the user interface, backend services, APIs, and data models, partnering with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and adjacent engineering teams. You will turn complex healthcare workflows into reliable, intuitive experiences and lead work from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operational support.

This is an opportunity to own a meaningful product area end to end, influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team, and raise the quality, reliability, and effectiveness of the systems and engineers around you.

  • Set and advance a multi-quarter technical direction for Member Records in partnership with engineering and product leadership.

  • Establish durable technical patterns for APIs, domain models, integrations, testing, observability, and secure handling of member data.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing.

  • Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features.

  • Raise the engineering bar through high-quality design and code reviews, pairing, mentoring, hiring participation, and coaching other engineers toward greater technical ownership.

  • Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).

  • Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT).

Basic Qualifications

  • 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful experience delivering production software.

Safety Research at OpenAI is responsible for ensuring our most capable models can be safely deployed in the real world. Our work focuses on making models helpful, reliable, and aligned with safety policies across model types, modalities, and product surfaces. We work across both longer-term safety research and the core post-training work needed to improve production models.

We are seeking researchers to advance safety training for OpenAI’s models. You will develop methods that improve model behavior after pretraining, including RLHF, RLAIF, DPO, PPO, preference optimization, adversarial training, synthetic data generation, safety evaluations, and model behavior analysis.

This role is highly cross-functional. You will work with core training teams, product teams, policy, legal, trust and safety, and domain experts to identify risks, design interventions, train models, evaluate outcomes, and launch safety improvements in OpenAI products.

title: Software Engineer, Scaled Abuse
description:
About the team

The Applied team safely brings OpenAI's technology to the world. We released ChatGPT; Plugins; DALL·E; and the APIs for GPT-5, embeddings, and fine-tuning. We also operate inference infrastructure at scale. There's a lot more on the immediate horizon.

Our customers build fast-growing businesses around our APIs, which power product features that were never before possible. ChatGPT is a prime example of what is currently possible. We simultaneously ensure that our powerful tools are used responsibly. Safe deployment is more important to us than unfettered growth.

The Fraud Engineering team works within our Applied Engineering organization identifying and responding to fraudsters on our platform. We are looking for a software engineer with anti fraud & abuse experience to help architect and build our next-generation anti-fraud systems.

About the role

The Scaled Abuse team protects OpenAI’s products and customers by detecting, preventing, and responding to fraudulent and abusive behavior at scale. We build and operate the backend and data systems that power real-time detection, investigation workflows, and enforcement — balancing strong protections with a great user experience as the platform grows.

Our work sits at the intersection of engineering and abuse expertise: we partner closely with Trust & Safety, Security, and Product to understand emerging attack patterns, translate messy signals into clear system behavior, and continuously harden our defenses. The problems are dynamic and ambiguous by default, so we value engineers who can quickly dive into an unfamiliar codebase, develop strong intuition about how it works end-to-end, and propose pragmatic improvements that make the entire stack more resilient.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build systems for fraud detection and remediation while balancing fraud loss, cost of implementation, and customer experience

  • Work closely with finance, security, product, research, and trust & safety operations to holistically combat fraudulent and abusive actors on our system

  • Stay abreast of the latest techniques and tools to stay several steps ahead of determined and well resourced adversaries

  • Utilize GPT-5 and future models to more effectively combat fraud and abuse

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of software engineering experience in backend and data systems.

  • Have at least 2 years experience in fraud or abuse analysis, investigation, and/or operations

  • Can dive into our codebase, intuit how it works, and be able to have a strong intuition for suggestions that will lead us to a stronger engineering position.

title: Training: ML Framework Engineer
description:
About the Team

Training Runtime designs the core distributed machine-learning training runtime that powers everything from early research experiments to frontier-scale model runs. With a dual mandate to accelerate researchers and enable frontier scale, we’re building a unified, modular runtime that meets researchers where they are and moves with them up the scaling curve.

Our work focuses on three pillars: high-performance, asynchronous, zero-copy tensor and optimizer-state-aware data movement; performant, high-uptime, fault-tolerant training frameworks (training loop, state management, resilient checkpointing, deterministic orchestration, and observability); and distributed process management for long-lived, job-specific and user-provided processes.

We integrate proven large-scale capabilities into a composable, developer-facing runtime so teams can iterate quickly and run reliably at any scale, partnering closely with model-stack, research, and platform teams. Success for us is measured by raising both training throughput (how fast models train) and researcher throughput (how fast ideas become experiments and products).

About the Role

As a Training: ML Framework Engineer, you will work on improving the training throughput for our internal training framework, while enabling researchers to experiment with new ideas.  This requires good engineering (for example designing, implementing, and optimizing state-of-the-art AI models), writing bug-free machine learning code (surprisingly difficult!), and acquiring deep knowledge of the performance of supercomputers. In all the projects this role pursues, the ultimate goal is to push the field forward.

We’re looking for people who love optimizing performance, understanding distributed systems, and who cannot stand having bugs in their code.  Since our training framework is used for large runs with massive numbers of GPUs, performance improvements here will have a large impact.
